description: Perennial. Rhizome creeping. Culms ± tufted, rhizome, 20–65 cm by 0.3–0.5 mm, triquetrous, smooth, glabrous. Leaves reduced to bladeless sheaths; sheaths 1–8 cm long, pale to mid-brown. Involucral bracts 2–3, subulate, 2–5 mm long, soon reflexed and hidden by inflorescence. Inflorescence capitate, ± globose, 0.8–1.4 cm diam. Spikelets numerous, subterete, lanceolate, 4–6 by ca 1 mm, 4–5-glumed, 1(–2)-flowered. Glumes elliptic to ovate-lanceolate, 1–5 by 0.5–1.5 mm, obtuse to acute, awned, sides membranous, pale brownish flecked with rusty brown, keel subacute, 3-nerved. Stamens 3; anthers 1.5–2 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets obovoid or globose-obovoid, trigonous, 1–1.2 by 0.7–0.8 mm, cream coloured to light brownish, often slightly shiny, smooth to veruculose, indistinctly reticulate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Actinoschoenus thouarsii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 419. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial. Culms 100–200 cm by 10–12 mm, sides concave. Leaves basal; blade 50–170 cm by 15–30 mm, gradually narrowed. 1-nerved, flattish-plicate; sheath up to 30 cm long. Involucral bracts 3–4, up to 50 cm long. Inflorescence simple to compound, 6–15 by 6–15 cm, primary branches up to 7 cm long scabrous above, secondary branches 1.5–4 cm long, scabrous. Spikelets solitary, pedicellate or sessile, ellipsoid to oblong-ellipsoid, 5–10 by 3.5–4 mm, rounded, light rusty brown to dark brown. Glumes elliptic to ovate-elliptic, 2.5–3 by 1.8–2 mm, obtuse, membranous, boat-shaped, ciliolate above and on upper margin, sides rusty brown to dark brown, keel green. Perianth segments slightly exceeding nutlet, retrorsely scabrous. Anthers 1.5 mm long. Nutlets 1–1.8 by 0.9–1 mm, reddish brown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Actinoscirpus grossus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 274. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual. Culms 17–32 cm by 0.5–1 mm, trigonous to subterete, smooth. Leaves: blade narrowly linear, 2–7 cm by 0.5–1.2 mm, subacute, flattish-canaliculate; sheath up to 7 cm long, reddish or purplish brown, ventrally white-scarious. Involucral bracts 3–4, reflexed, dilated at base, the longest 9–15 cm long. Spikes 1–3, ellipsoid to globose, central spike 5–10 by 4–5 mm, lateral spikes (when present) much smaller. Spikelet bracts spathulate to obovate-oblanceolate, 1.4–1.6 by 0.4–0.6 mm, cuspidate; adaxial seta present, 1 mm long. Glumes oblong-obovate, margins partially enclosing flower, 0.8–1.2 mm long, apex elongated, recurved, 1.3–1.5 mm long, yellowish to pale brown, indistinctly 5-nerved. Stamen 1; anther 0.2–0.3 mm long. Nutlets oblong-obovoid, trigonous to subterete, 0.7–0.8 by 0.4 mm, maturing dark brown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Ascolepis dipsacoides siamensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 403. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual. Culms up to 9.5 cm by 0.3–0.4 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves: blade linear, 3–9 cm by 0.7–0.8 mm, long acute, flattish to canaliculate; sheath ca 1 cm long, pale to mid-brown. Involucral bracts 3–4, reflexed, dilated at base, the longest 2.5–4.7 cm long. Spikes 3–4, ellipsoid to globose, central spike 4–6 by 3–4.5 mm, lateral spikes smaller. Spikelet bracts linear, 1.1–1.2 by 0.1 mm, acute. Glumes pouch-like, completely enclosing achene, 1.5–1.6 mm long including awn, the awn 0.3–0.4 mm long, erect or slightly recurved, whitish, prominently several-nerved. Stamen 1. Nutlets oblong obovate, flattened-trigonous, 0.5–0.7 by 0.3 mm, pale to dark brown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Ascolepis pusilla. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 405. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial. Culms usually solitary, occasionally 2–3, 8–3 cm by 1–2 mm, trigonous to triquetrous, smooth, base thickened, fibrous. Leaves ± basal; blade linear, 6–20 cm by 2–4 mm, gradually narrowed, acuminate; sheath 2–10 cm long, pale brown, ventral side truncate at apex. Involucral bracts 2–3, the lowest 3–15 cm long, patent to reflexed, or erect and continuous with culm, sheath absent. Inflorescence terminal or pseudolateral, capitate, comprising 1–5(–7) spikelets. Spikelets ellipsoid to ovoid-ellipsoid, terete, 8–20 by 3–10 mm, pale yellowish to pale brownish. Glumes ovate-elliptic to broadly elliptic, 6–8 by 2–2.7 mm, acute, often 2-toothed, pubescent, awn up to 1 mm long. Perianth segments 0–4, minutely retrorsely scabrous. Anthers 2 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets broadly obovate, biconvex, 2–3 by 1.5–1.8 mm, shiny, brown, minutely reticulate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Bolboschoenus maritimus affinis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 271. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual. Culms densely tufted, 5–30 cm by 0.2–0.4 mm, ± terete, smooth, glabrous. Leaves basal; blade filiform, 4–10 cm by 0.2–0.5 mm, acute, glabrous to sparsely pilose above; sheaths 0.5–2 cm long, brownish. Involucral bracts 1–3, setaceous, the longest 0.3–2.5 cm long. Inflorescence capitate, 5–15 mm wide. Spikelets 2–20, lanceolate to ovoid-conical, angular, 3–8 by 1–1.8 mm. Glumes 7–15 per spikelet, ovate, 1.5–2.3 by 1–1.5 mm, acute, recurved-mucronate, sides membranous, yellowish green to rusty or chestnut brown, ciliolate to puberulent, margins hyaline, keel acute. Stamen 1; anther 0.2–0.3 mm long. Nutlets obovoid-orbicular, trigonous, 0.6–0.8 by 0.4–0.6 mm, whitish, smooth to finely papillose.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Bulbostylis barbata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 345. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual. Culms tufted, filiform, 5–40 cm by 0.2–0.5 mm, smooth, glabrous. Leaves basal; blade filiform, 2–10 cm by 0.4–0.5 mm, acute, glabrous to sparsely pilose; sheath pale brown. Involucral bracts setaceous to ± glume-like, the longest up to 0.7 cm long. Inflorescence simple to compound, sometimes condensed and appearing ± capitate; primary branches 1–5, 2–5 cm long. Spikelets (1–)2–8, solitary or clustered, cylindric ovoid to ovoid, somewhat angular, 3–6 mm by 1.5 mm. Glumes 5–18 per spikelet, ovate to broadly ovate, 1.5–2 by 1 mm, subacute, sides membranous, glabrous, light chestnut brown, margins hyaline, keel acute, pale brown. Stamens 2; anthers 0.2–0.3 mm long. Nutlets obovoid-orbicular, trigonous, 0.7–0.9 by 0.5–0.8 mm, maturing greyish, indistinctly transversely wrinkled, minutely papillose.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Bulbostylis densa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 343. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual. Culms densely tufted, 7–40 cm by 0.3–0.8 mm, scabrid, glabrous to puberulent. Leaves basal; blade filiform, 2-9 cm by 0.3-0.6 mm, glabrous to puberulent; sheath 0.8–3 cm long, pubescent, pale brown. Involucral bracts 2–4, leaf-like, the longest up to 4 cm long. Inflorescence simple, often condensed and appearing ± capitate, 1–1.5 by 1.5 cm. Spikelets (1–)5–20, solitary, ovoid to cylindric-ovoid, angular, 4–8 by 1.4–1.6 mm. Glumes 5–14 per spikelet, broadly ovate, 1.7–2.2 by 1.5–2 mm, acute, recurved-mucronate, sides membranous, pale greenish to light brown, densely pubescent, margins hyaline, keel acute. Stamen 1; anther 0.5–0.7 mm long. Nutlets broadly obovoid, triquetrous, 0.8–1 by 0.5–0.8 mm, whitish to pale yellowish, transversely wrinkled, obscurely reticulate with longitudinally oblong epidermal cells.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Bulbostylis puberula. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 343. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culm central, 20–50 cm by 1.5–2 mm, triquetrous, smooth. Leaves basal; blade broadly linear, 15–75 cm by 5–20 mm, acute to shortly acuminate, flat; sheath 5–12 cm long, pale greenish to brown. Lowest involucral bract leaf-like, 15–30 cm long. Inflorescence with 2–3 nodes each subtending 1(–2) rather distant spikes; terminal spike male, rarely androgynous, lateral spikes female. Male spike linear, 3–6 cm long, subsquarrose. Female spikes shortly pedunculate, oblong-cylindric, 4–8 cm long. Female glumes oblong to oblong-lanceolate, 2–3 mm long, obtuse to shallowly 2 lobed. awned, the awn 5–15 mm long, sides membranous, pale green or brown, nerves 0, keel 3-nerved. Utricles suberect, lanceolate or ellipsoid-lageniform, trigonous, 7–10 by 2–2.8 mm, slightly inflated, greenish, glabrous, gradually narrowed into beak; beak 2.5–3 mm long, apex deeply 2-toothed, teeth up to 1 mm long, recurved. Stigmas 3. Nutlets obovate-elliptic, trigonous, 4–5 by 1–2 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carex anomocarya. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 472. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms loosely tufted, 60–150 cm by 4–7 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves cauline, blade linear, up to 100 cm by 5–15 mm, gradually narrowed, long acute, flattish; sheath 10–16 cm long, greenish to reddish brown, the basal sheaths becoming fibrous. Lowest involucral bract leaf-like, exceeding inflorescence. Inflorescence paniculate; nodes 5–8, lower ones distant, each subtending 1 partial inflorescence; partial inflorescences 5–25 cm long, branched into 5–20 spikes. Spikes cylindric, 2–6 cm long, upper section male, lower female. Female glumes ovate to elliptic, 2.5–3.5 mm long, acute to obtuse, often mucronate, sides herbaceous, pale brown, glabrous or hispid. Utricles ellipsoid to subglobose, indistinctly trigonous, 3.5–4.2 by 1.7–2.5 mm, much inflated, 6–8-nerved, whitish or green at first, maturing dark reddish or blackish, abruptly narrowed into beak; beak 0.3–0.7 mm long, margins hispid, apex 2-toothed. Stigmas 3. Nutlets elliptic, trigonous, 2.7–3 by 1–1.2 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carex baccans. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 452. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial. Culms tufted, lateral, 3–13 cm by 0.3–0.5 mm, triquetrous, scabrid above. Leaves basal; blade linear, 15–50 cm by 2–5 mm, long-acuminate, flattish-plicate; sheath 1–2 cm long, mid- to dark brown, becoming fibrous. Lowest involucral bract leaf-like, 1.5–2.5 cm long. Inflorescence 0.8–2 cm long; nodes 2–4, crowded, each subtending a single spike; terminal spike male, lateral spikes female. Male spike linear-clavate, 0.3–0.5 cm long. Female spikes ± sessile, broadly ellipsoid to subglobose, 0.5–0.7 cm long. Female glumes deltoid to deltoid-lanceolate, 1.5–2.7 mm long, acute or acuminate, shortly mucronate, sides membranous, nerves 0, whitish, keel 3-nerved. Utricles patent, ovoid-rhombic, trigonous, 3.5–4 by 1.6–1.8 mm, glaucous, 10–14 nerved, glabrous to puberulent; beak conical, 0.6 mm long, apex deeply 2-toothed, teeth up to 0.5 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly ovate, triquetrous, 2.3–2.4 by 1.6 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carex blinii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 472. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial. Culms tufted, almost hidden, 10–30 cm by 1 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal; blade linear, 25–90 cm by 4–7 mm, long-acute, flattish-plicate; sheaths up to 2 cm long, mid- to dark purplish-brown on veins, eventually becoming fibrous. Lowest involucral bract leaf-like, up to 40 cm long. Inflorescence 8–9 cm long; nodes 5–8(–20), usually subtending a single spike sometimes with branching at lower nodes; terminal spike male, lateral spikes female or often androgynous with short male section above. Male spike shortly pedunculate, erect, narrowly linear, 1–2 cm long. Androgynous/female spikes ± sessile to pedunculate, ± erect, narrowly cylindric, 1–3 cm long. Female glumes oblong-elliptic or oblong-ovate, 2–by 1–1.8 mm, obtuse or rounded, shortly mucronate, sides membranous, faintly several-nerved, whitish or pale brown, margins hyaline, ciliolate at apex. Utricles erect-patent, rhomboid-lageniform, trigonous, 3.7–5 by 1.2–1.5 mm, pale green, faintly many-veined, glabrous to sparsely puberulent above; beak conical, 0.5–1 mm long, apex 2-toothed. Stigmas 3. Nutlets rhombic-fusiform, 2.5–3 by 1.2–1.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carex breviscapa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 474. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms central, 70–100 cm by 1–2 mm, triquetrous, smooth. Leaves basal and cauline; blade linear-lanceolate, 15–70 cm by (10–)20–40 mm, acuminate, flat, base gradually narrowed into pseudopetiole (3–)7–18 cm long; sheath up to 3 cm long, greenish. Lowest involucral bract setaceous, 1–3.5 cm long, shorter than inflorescence. Inflorescence terminal, paniculate, elliptic or broadly elliptic, 6–19 by 3–7 cm, branched, branches up to 3.5 cm long. Spikes ovoid, 0.8–1.5 cm long, androgynous, upper section male, lower female. Female glumes ovate, 1.8–2.5 by 1.2–1.5 mm, acute to subobtuse, shortly awned, sides membranous, pale brown, keel 3 nerved. Utricles patent, ellipsoid to ovoid-ellipsoid, trigonous, 3.2–3.7 by 1.3–1.6 mm, olive green, 8–12-nerved, glabrous, rather gradually narrowed into beak; beak 1–1.5 mm long, glabrous, apex 2-toothed. Stigmas 3. Nutlets ovoid-ellipsoid, triquetrous, 2–2.3 by 1.2–1.3 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carex cataphyllodes. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 462. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizomatous perennial; rhizome woody, knotted. Culms 50–90 cm by 2–3.5 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal and cauline; blade lanceolate to linear-oblanceolate, 30–70 cm by (13–)20–30 mm, acute, flattish, gradually narrowed into pseudopetiole 8–12 cm long; sheath 2–10 cm long, pale brown to purplish brown, basal sheaths becoming fibrous. Lowest involucral bract leaf-like, up to 15 cm long, equalling or exceeding inflorescence. Inflorescence paniculate, 7–25 cm by 3–5 cm; nodes 2–5, lower 1–2 usually distant, upper crowded, each subtending 1 partial inflorescence; partial inflorescence pedunculate, ovoid-pyramidal, 3–7 cm long, branched, the branches 1–3 cm long. Spikes 0.5–1 cm long, androgynous, upper section male, lower female. Female glumes ovate to oblong-ovate, 1.8–2.5 mm long, subacute to obtuse, shortly awned, sides membranous, ciliate on upper margins, pale brown, keel 3-nerved. Utricles patent, ovoid-ellipsoid, trigonous, 3–4 by 1.3–1.6 mm, olive-green, 6–10 nerved, glabrous or hispid above, rather gradually narrowed into beak; beak 1–1.5 mm long, hispidulous, obliquely truncate. Stigmas 3. Nutlets rhombic-ellipsoid, triquetrous, 2–2.5 by 1.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carex commixta. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 461. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms up to 60 cm by 1.4 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal and cauline; blade narrowly linear, up to 46 cm by 2.5–3 mm, long-acuminate, flat; sheath 7–14 cm long, greenish to reddish. Lowest involucral bract leaf-like, up to 38 cm long. Inflorescence 16–28 cm long, with 5–8 nodes each subtending 1 spike only or 1 branch with up to 3 spikes. Spikes sessile or very shortly pedunculate, cylindric, 3–5.5 cm long, upper section male, lower female, many-flowered. Female glumes lanceolate, 3–4 by 0.8–1.2 mm, acute, awned, the awn 0.8–1.2 mm long, sides membranous, mid-brown, keel greenish. Utricles broadly elliptic, trigonous, 1.8–2 by 1.1–1.5 mm, not or slightly inflated, greenish maturing pale to mid-brown, nerves 0, densely hispid above, rather abruptly narrowed into beak; beak 0.5–0.8 mm long, apex 2-toothed. Stigmas 3. Nutlets elliptic-obovoid, trigonous, 1.5–1.7 by 1–1.1 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carex composita. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 453. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Similar to C. cruciata but: partial inflorescences oblong to oblong-lanceolate, up to 15 cm long. Spikelets with male section 5–8 mm long. Male glumes 3.7–5 mm long. Female glumes sometimes ± hispidulous. Utricles hardly inflated, 0.8–1.2 mm wide darkish green.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carex condensata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 456. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms loosely tufted, 30–90 cm by 1–2.8 mm, triquetrous, smooth. Leaves basal and cauline; blade narrowly linear, 25–75 cm by 2–8(–10) mm, long-acuminate, flattish-plicate; sheath 2–6 cm long, green to dark purplish brown, basal sheaths becoming fibrous. Lowest involucral bract leaf-like, 30–50 cm long. Inflorescence narrow, paniculate, (6–)15–30 cm long, nodes (2–)5–7, distant, each subtending 1(–2) partial inflorescences; partial inflorescences sessile to pedunculate, narrowly elliptic to narrowly ovate, 1.5–7 by 1–2 cm, branched below, the branches 2–5-spicate, hispid. Spikes ellipsoid-cylindric, 0.4–0.9 cm long, upper section male, 0.2–0.4 cm long, lower female. Male glumes 2.2–2.9 mm long. Female glumes ovate, 1.2–2.8 by 1–1.7 mm, obtuse to subobtuse, awned, sides membranous, faintly 4–5-nerved, reddish brown. Utricles patent, recurved, narrowly ellipsoid to obovoid-ellipsoid, trigonous, 3–4.3 by 0.8–1 mm, greenish, tinged with reddish brown, several-nerved, hispid above, gradually narrowed into beak; beak 1–1.2 mm long, apex 2-toothed. Stigmas 3. Nutlets elliptic, 1.7–2.5 by 0.8–1 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carex continua. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 454. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms densely tufted, 20–60 cm by 1–1.5 mm, triquetrous, smooth. Leaves mostly cauline, lower ones with reduced blades; blades narrowly linear, up to 21 cm by 1.7–3 mm long-acute, flattish; sheaths 2–5 cm long, pale green to dark brown, basal sheaths becoming somewhat fibrous. Lowest involucral bract leaf like, up to 23 cm long. Inflorescence linear, spike-like, 5–13 cm long, with 10–16 rather distant spikes. Spikes erect-patent, ellipsoid, 0.5–0.9 by 0.4–0.6 cm, androgynous, upper section female, lower male, few-flowered. Female glumes ovate to ovate lanceolate, 2.2–2.8 mm long, acute to acuminate, often mucronate, sides membranous to scarious, keel 3-nerved. Utricles elliptic to ovate-elliptic, compressed, 3–3.2 by 1–1.3 mm, winged, light green, 8–12-nerved, glabrous; beak ca 1 mm long, apex 2-toothed. Stigmas 2. Nutlets oblong-ovate, compressed, 2 by 0.7–0.8 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carex craspedotricha. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 483. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Rhizome woody, creeping to ascending, covered with fibrous leaf sheath remains. Culms several, lateral, 10–50 cm by 0.3–1 mm, trigonous, flexuous, smooth. Involucral bracts reduced to short-bladed sheaths 0.7–2 cm long. Inflorescence 6–27 cm long; nodes up to 6, each subtending 1 partial inflorescence or a single spike, the partial inflorescences 3–12 by 1 cm, with up to 8 spikes. Spikes erect, ± sessile to shortly pedunculate, cylindric, 1–3 cm long, androgynous, upper section male, lower female. Female glumes ovate, 2.2–2.8 mm long, acute to subacute, very shortly mucronate, sides membranous, indistinctly several-nerved, pale brown, keel indistinctly 3-nerved. Utricles erect, obovate to obovate-fusiform, trigonous, 3.5–5.5 by 1.5–2 mm, pale brown, finely many-nerved, sparsely puberulent above, rather abruptly narrowed into beak; beak 0.5–0.7 mm long, apex minutely 2-toothed. Stigmas 3. Nutlets ellipsoid, trigonous with sides concave above, 2 by 1 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carex cryptostachys. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 470. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Habit very similar to that of C. phacota, but culms 25–70 cm tall and leaves somewhat shorter. Inflorescence with 3–8 spikes, upper crowded, lower more distant; terminal spike androgynous with male section above and below and female in middle, lateral spikes androgynous with upper section male, lower female or female. Androgynous spike pedunculate, erect to nodding, 3–7 cm long. Female spikes pedunculate, nodding, cylindric, 2–7 cm long. Female glumes oblong to oblong-spathulate, 1.5–2.5 mm long, rounded or shallowly emarginate, awned, awn 0.5–4 mm long, sides membranous, whitish spotted with reddish brown, keel 3-nerved. Utricles patent, broadly elliptic or somewhat obovate-orbicular, compressed, 3–3.8 by 1.5–2.5 mm, yellowish green to reddish brown, densely papillose, rounded above into beak; beak 0.3–0.4 mm long, apex truncate. Stigmas 2. Nutlets suborbicular, compressed, 1.8–2 by 1.2–1.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carex dimorpholepis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 482. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms solitary or tufted, up to 160 cm by 2–2.5 mm, triquetrous, smooth. Leaves basal and cauline; blade linear, up to 150 by 7–20 mm, long-acuminate, conduplicate; sheath 4–6 cm long, greenish to brown, basal sheaths becoming fibrous. Inflorescence paniculate, up to 60 cm long; nodes 4–7, distant, each subtending 1 partial inflorescence; partial inflorescence pedunculate, oblong-ellipsoid, up to 14 cm long, branched, the branches bearing several spikes. Spikes ellipsoid globose, 0.4–0.9 cm long, androgynous, upper section male, 0.2–0.4 cm long, lower female. Male glumes 2.5–3.3 mm long. Female glumes ovate-deltoid, 1.8–2.3 mm long, acute, shortly cuspidate, sides hyaline, brownish, keel 1-nerved. Utricles spreading, oblong-ovoid, trigonous, 2.5–3.5 by 0.5–0.7 mm, many-nerved, apex gradually narrowed to beak; beak 1–1.5 mm long, glabrous, apex deeply 2-toothed. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly ellipsoid, triquetrous, 1.4 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carex doisutepensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 455. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial. Culms loosely tufted, 20–80 cm by 1–3 mm, triquetrous, smooth. Leaves basal; blade linear, up to 40 cm by 2–7 mm, long-acuminate, flattish; sheath up to 10 cm long, pale brown. Lowest involucral bract leaf-like, 12–20 cm long. Inflorescence with 4–9(–12) spikes, upper 2–5(–6) male, remainder female, rarely with short male section above. Male spikes suberect, sessile, crowded, clavate to cylindric, 1–5 cm long. Female (androgynous) spikes suberect, sessile to pedunculate, distant, oblong-cylindric, 1–5 cm by 5–7 mm. Female glumes ovate to ovate-lanceolate, 2.5–4 mm long, acute, obtuse or ± emarginate, awned, awn 1–2 mm long, sides membranous, keel 3-nerved. Utricles patent, ovoid to ovoid-ellipsoid, trigonous, 3.5–5 by 1.5–2.2 mm, somewhat inflated, yellowish green to brown, 6–10-nerved, densely hispid, gradually to ± abruptly narrowed into beak; beak 1–1.2 mm long, apex 2-toothed. Stigmas 3. Nutlets elliptic, trigonous, 2–3 by 1–1.7 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carex fedia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 478. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms loosely tufted, 30–160 cm by 1–5 mm, triquetrous, smooth. Leaves basal and cauline; blade linear to broadly linear, 30–70 cm by (4–)7–12 mm, long-acute flat; sheath 2–10 cm long, greenish to reddish or purple brown, basal sheaths becoming fibrous. Lowest involucral bract leaf-like, usually shorter than inflorescence. description: Rhizomatous perennial; rhizome woody. Culms loosely tufted, 90–140 cm by 2–3 mm, triquetrous, sinooth. description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms tufted, up to 30 cm by 0.4–0.5 mm, triquetrous, scabrid. description: Stoloniferous perennial. Culm solitary, 20–40 cm by 0.8–1.5 mm, triquetrous, smoothish to scabrid on angles. description: Stoloniferous perennial. Culms 1-few, 60–90 cm by 4–7 mm, smooth, sharply triquetrous, sides shallowly concave. description: Shortly rhizomatous perennial. Culms 10–40 cm by 1–3 mm, trigonous to triquetrous above, smooth. description: Shortly rhizomatous perennial. Culms loosely tufted, 0.5–6(–10) cm by 1–2 mm, triquetrous, smooth, often hidden by leaf sheath. description: Stoloniferous perennial. Culms tuberous at base, 10–60 cm by 1–2 mm, triquetrous, smooth. Leaves: blade linear, up to 60 cm by 2–5 mm, acuminate, flattish; sheath pale brown. description: Annual. Culms tufted or solitary, 20–60 cm by 1–2 mm, smooth, triquetrous. Glumes 10–40 per spikelet, spirally imbricate, ovate, 1–1.5 by 0.6–0.8 mm, acute, recurved-mucronate to shortly cuspidate, sides membranous, yellowish brown, keel subacute, finely 3-nerved, green. Stamen 1; anther 0.3 mm long. Stigmas 2. Style-base glabrous or ciliolate. Nutlets obovate, thickly biconvex, 0.5–0.6 by 0.3–0.4 mm, maturing yellowish, sometimes slightly shiny, smooth or faintly cancellate with a few rows of transversely oblong epidermal cells.

description: Glumes 1.5–2 by ca 1 mm, mucronate. Style-base pilose, with a tuft of silky white hairs. Nutlets broadly obovate 0.6–1 by 0.5–0.7 mm.

description: Annual. Culms tufted, 12–50 cm by 0.5–1 mm, angular, smooth. Leaves basal; blade linear, 4–20 cm by 1–2 mm, shortly acuminate, flat, margins incurved, glaucous; sheath 1–5 cm long, pale greenish to pale brown; ligule a fringe of short hairs. Involucral bracts 1–3, leaf-like, up to 5 cm long. Inflorescence simple to compound, open, 2–7 by 2–7 cm; primary branches 2–6, up to 5 cm long. Spikelets (3–)5–14 per inflorescence, solitary, ovoid to ovoid-cylindric, 4–8 by 2–2.5 mm. Glumes 15–30 per spikelet, spirally arranged, broadly ovate, 1.8–2.2 by 1.5–1.7 mm, obtuse, sides thinly chartaceous, pale brown to yellowish brown, sometimes with darker reddish brown, margins white-hyaline, keel obtuse, 3-nerved, glaucous. Stamen 1; anther 0.5 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets broadly obovate, biconvex, 1–1.3 by 0.7–0.9 mm, with 10–16 shallowly cancellate longitudinal rows of transversely oblong epidermal cells, verruculose.

description: Perennial. Culms densely tufted, slender, 60–100 cm by 2 mm, sharply 5-angled, smooth to slightly scabrid above. Leaves basal and cauline, the latter reduced to bladeless sheaths; blade linear, 7–15 cm by 1–2 mm, abruptly acute, flattish; sheath up to 20 cm long, obliquely truncate, reddish brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 4–6, leaf-like, the lowest 1–2 suberect, the longest 4–8 cm long. Inflorescence compound to decompound, open, 8–20 by 8–10 cm; primary branches 6–9, up to 12 cm long. Spikelets numerous per inflorescence, ovoid, angular, 2–3 by 1–1.5 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally arranged, ovate or ovate-orbicular, 1.2–1.5 by 1.2–1.5 mm, acute, sides chartaceous, yellowish brown, margins hyaline above, keel obtuse, dark brown. Stamens 1–2; anthers 0.3–0.4 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly obovoid, trigonous, 0.6–0.8 by 0.5–0.6 mm pale brown, smooth or with 10–13, indistinct longitudinal rows of epidermal cells on each side.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms 30–60(–90) cm by 2–3 mm, 4–5-angled, smooth or scabrid below. Leaves basal on sterile shoots, or cauline reduced to bladeless sheaths; blade linear, up to 30 cm by 2–4 mm, abruptly acute, flattish; sheath 5–20 cm long, obliquely truncate; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2–3, leaf-like, the longest 1–2 cm long. Inflorescence decompound, 3–10 by 3–10 cm; primary branches up to 7 cm long. Spikelets numerous per inflorescence, ovoid to ovoid-globose, 2.5–3.5 by 1.5–2 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally arranged, ovate, 1.2–1.5 by 1 mm, obtuse, sides membranous, yellowish brown to dark brown, margins broad-hyaline, pale brownish or whitish, keel obtuse, 1-nerved, pale brown. Stamens 1–2; anthers 0.5 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets obovoid, trigonous with slightly thickened angles, 0.7–0.8 by 0.4–0.5 mm, white to cream, densely verruculose, with 4–6 longitudinal rows of epidermal cells on each side.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms densely tufted, 5–20 cm by 0.5–1 mm, trigonous, smooth, glabrous. Leaves basal; blade narrowly linear, 3–20 cm by 0.5–1 mm, subacute, canaliculate to inrolled-margined, glabrous to spinulose-scabrous on margin; sheath 1–3 cm long, pale greenish, light brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 3–5, leaf-like, the longest 5–10 cm long. Inflorescence capitate, semi-globose to globose, 1–1.7 cm diam. Spikelets 8–39 per inflorescence, narrowly cylindric, terete, 3.5–7(–10) by 1–1.5 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, ovate, 3–4 by 1.5–2 mm, acute, mucronulate, sides thinly membranous, yellowish brown, margins pale-hyaline, keel subacute, 3-nerved, greenish. Stamen 1; anther 0.3–0.4 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets widely obovate, biconvex, 0.5–0.7 by 0.4–0.5 mm, maturing yellow, ± smooth to minutely verruculose.

description: Annual. Culms densely tufted, 5–20 cm by 0.3–0.7 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal; blade narrowly linear, 3–14 cm by 0.5–1.5 mm, obtuse, flattish, margins weakly incurved; sheath 1–3 cm long, pale greenish to cinnamon brown, pubescent, apex obliquely truncate; ligule a fringe of hairs. Involucral bracts 1–3, leaf-like, the longest 1.3–7 cm long, slightly shorter to exceeding inflorescence. Inflorescence compound to decompound, dense, 2–6 cm by 2–4 cm; primary branches 4–10, 1–4 cm long. Spikelets many (over 20) per inflorescence, solitary, cylindric-ovoid, subterete, 2–8 by 1.2–1.5(–1.8) mm. Glumes 10–30 per spikelet, spirally imbricate, broadly ovate, 1–1.8 by 0.7–1 mm, subacute, mucronate, sides membranous, yellowish brown, margins pale-hyaline, keel subacute, ± 3-nerved, greenish. Stamen 1; anther 0.5 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets broadly obovate, thickly biconvex, 0.5–0.8 by 0.5–0.8 mm, pale yellowish, yellow, deeply cancellate with 5–7 longitudinal rows of transversely oblong epidermal cells.

description: Perennial. Culms tufted, 5–12 cm by 0.3–0.5 mm, angular, smooth. Leaves basal; slade filiform, 3–9 cm by 0.3–0.5 mm, acute, canaliculate with thickened margins, glabrous; sheath 1–2.5 cm long, rusty brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 3–4, filiform, the longest 3–6 cm long. Inflorescence simple to compound, 5–7 by 2–5 cm, rather dense; primary branches 4–5, up to 4 cm long. Spikelets 7–16 per inflorescence, solitary or clusters of 2–3, ± erect, linear-cylindric, angular, 1.5–2.5 cm by 0.7–1 mm. Glumes 18–25 per spikelet, spirally arranged, lanceolate, 2.7–3.2 by 1–1.3 mm, acute with weakly recurved awn ca 1 mm long, sides thinly membranous, 3–5-nerved, rusty brown, margins paler hyaline, keel acute, greenish. Stamens 1–2; anthers 0.7 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets narrowly obovate, biconvex, 0.8–0.9 by 0.3–0.4 mm, maturing brown, cancellate with 7–8 (abaxial side) and 3–4 (adaxial side) longitudinal rows of epidermal cells.

description: Perennial, rarely annual. Rhizome somewhat creeping. Culms moderately tufted to ± distant, (10–)20–50 cm by 0.5–1 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal, 2-ranked; blade filiform, 4–22 cm by 0.3–0.6 mm, subacute, canaliculate, margins inrolled; sheath 1.5–5 cm long, obliquely truncate, ciliate at apex; ligule a fringe of short white hairs. Involucral bracts 2–3, leaf-like, the longest 1–5 cm long, shorter than inflorescence. Inflorescence compound to decompound, open, 2–7 by 2–7 cm; primary branches 3–6, 0.8–5 cm long. Spikelets 10–90 per inflorescence, solitary, ovate-lanceolate to lanceolate, flattened, 4–8 by 1.2–1.5 mm. Glumes 6–10 per spikelet, 2-ranked, ovate or narrowly ovate 2.7–4 by 1.2–2 mm, acuminate, sides membranous, light brown to deep reddish brown, densely gland-dotted, keel acute, 1–3-nerved. Stamens 3; anthers 1.5–2 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets narrowly obovoid or obovoid-oblong, trigonous to nearly subterete, 0.8–1 by 0.3–0.5 mm, transversely ridged and cancellate with 4–5 rows of linear epidermal cells.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms crowded in series along rhizome to ± tufted, 30–70 cm by 0.9–5 mm, flattened, smooth to scabrid, narrowly winged above. Glumes 5–20 per spikelet spirally arranged, ovate to ovate-lanceolate, 1.8–2.5(–3) mm long, mucronate, sides chartaceous, yellowish brown to brown, margins paler, keel acute, green. Stamens 2–3; anthers 1 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly obovoid, trigonous, 0.5–0.7 by 0.3–0.4 mm whitish, finely cancellate with several rows of transversely oblong epidermal cells.

description: Rhizomatous perennial; rhizome not or hardly elongated. Culms tufted, 5–60 cm by 1–2 mm, trigonous, smooth. Spikelets few to numerous per inflorescence, ellipsoid-cylindric to ovoid-cylindric, 2–6 by 1–2 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, closely imbricate, ovate to broadly ovate, 1–2.2 by 0.5–1.5 mm, obtuse, sides membranous, mid-brown, margins broadly white-hyaline, keel obtuse, obscurely 3–5-nerved, paler brown. Stamens 1–3; anthers 0.8–1 mm long, connective smooth. Stigmas 2(–3). Nutlets obovate, biconvex to rarely compressed-trigonous, 0.7–0.9 by 0.5–0.7 mm, maturing dark brown to black, smooth to indistinctly cancellate.

description: Annual to short-lived perennial. Culms loosely tufted, 10–70 cm by 0.5–2.5 mm, trigonous, glabrous to sparsely pubescent smooth. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally arranged, broadly ovate to suborbicular, 1.5–3(–4) by 1.5–2.2 mm, subacute, mucronate, sides thinly chartaceous, 2–4-nerved or nerves 0, mid-brown to dark reddish brown, margins pale-hyaline, keel obtuse, greenish to pale brown. Stamens (1–)2–3; anthers 0.5–1.7 mm long. Stigmas 2. description: Annual. Culms 2–15 cm by 0.25–0.5 mm, trigonous, smooth. description: Annual. Culms solitary or tufted, 10–40 cm by 0.2–1 mm, acutely 4–5-angled, smooth. description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms 1-few, 10–70 cm by 0.5–3 mm, 4–5-angled, smooth. description: Rhizomatous perennial; rhizome elongated, thick, woody, covered with fibrous leaf sheath remnants. Culms ± sparsely tufted, 7–30 cm by 0.5–0.8 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal, many, rosette-forming; blade linear, falcate, 1.5–5(–12) cm by 0.5–3 mm, acute, mucronulate, flattish with incurved margins; sheath 0.5–2 cm long, pale to mid brown; ligule 0. Spikelets few-many per inflorescence, solitary or in clusters of 2–5, ovoid or ovoid-ellipsoid, subterete, 4–5.5 by 1.5–2.3 mm. description: Rhizomatous, often clump-forming perennial, the rhizome often somewhat creeping. Culms tufted, or crowded along creeping rhizome, 15–5 cm by 0.5–1.5 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves arising on lower part of culm; blade narrowly linear, 1–15 cm by 0.6–2.5 mm, obtuse, canaliculate to inrolled-margined; sheath cylindric 2–12 cm long, pale glaucous to brown or orange brown, apex truncate; ligule a fringe of short hairs. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally imbricate, broadly ovate-elliptic or broadly ovate, 3.5–4.2 by 1.8–2.8 mm, obtuse, mucronate, sides thinly chartaceous, pale to dark brown, sparsely to densely shortly pubescent, margins ciliate, keel obtuse, 1-nerved. Nutlets broadly obovate, biconvex, 1–1.2 by 0.7–0.8 mm, maturing light orange brown or yellowish brown, smooth, with indistinct isodiametric epidermal cells.

description: Annual. Culms tufted, rather weak, 4–12 cm by 0.3–0.5 mm, 4–5-angled, smooth to scabrid above. description: Rhizomatous perennial; rhizome covered with fibrous leaf sheath remnants. Culms few-several, (15–)30–55 cm by 0.5–1 mm, angular, smooth to hispid-scabrid above. description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms densely tufted, 8–20(–27) cm by 0.2–0.5 mm, setaceous, smooth. Leaves basal; blade filiform, 3–10 cm by 0.5–0.7 mm, flattish canaliculate, abruptly subacute; sheaths up to 2 cm long, light cinnamon brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2–3, setaceous, the longest 0.5–1 cm long, shorter than inflorescence. Inflorescence compound, open, 1–4 by 1–2 cm; primary branches 2–4, 1–2.5 cm long. Spikelets 4–18 per inflorescence, lanceolate, strongly flattened, 4–6 by 1–1.5 mm. Glumes 5–8 per spikelet, 2-ranked, lanceolate, subacute, 3–3.5 by 1.2–1.5 mm, subacute, sides membranous, brown with reddish gland-dots, upper margins hyaline, keel acute, 1-nerved. Stamens 3; anthers 1–1.3 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets obovoid, trigonous, 0.6–0.8 by 0.4–0.5 mm, whitish, indistinctly reticulate with isodiametric epidermal cells.

description: Annual. Culms sparsely tufted, 7–30 cm by 0.5–0.8 mm, 3–4-angular, smooth, sparsely hairy below inflorescence. Leaves basal; blades narrowly linear to filiform, 5–30 cm by 0.5–1.5 mm, flattish or margins inrolled, glabrous to pubescent; sheath 1-5 cm long, pale to mid-brown. Involucral bracts 2–3, the longest leaf-like, 6–12 cm long. Inflorescence simple to compound, 3–10 by 1.5–8 cm; primary branches filiform, 4–7, up to 7 cm long at least some over 3.5 cm long. Spikelets 12–25 per inflorescence, solitary, narrowly conical, terete, 3–8 cm by 1–1.3 mm. Glumes 8–20 per spikelet, spirally arranged or the upper ones 2-ranked, ovate or oblong-ovate, 2–2.3 by 1–1.5 mm, acute, recurved mucronate, sides membranous, brown, margins broadly hyaline, keel obtuse, 3–5 nerved. Stamens 1–2; anthers 0.5 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets obovate, biconvex with prominent margins, 0.7–0.9 by 0.5–0.6 mm, whitish to light reddish brown, papillose.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Fimbristylis gracilenta. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 331. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Annual. Culms densely tufted, (3–)10–30 cm by 0.5–1.2 mm, 3–5-angled, smooth. Leaves basal; blade narrowly linear, occasionally subfalcate, 4–20 cm by 1–2 mm, subacute, flattish or with inrolled margins, glabrous; sheath up to 3 cm long, pale green or light reddish brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 4–6, leaf-like, the longest 1.2–2 cm long. Inflorescence simple to decompound, 4–8 by 4–8 cm, rather dense; primary branches 2–7, up to 3 cm long. Spikelets many per inflorescence, usually crowded, solitary, ovoid, ellipsoid or narrowly conical, 3–7 by 1–1.5 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally arranged, ovate-deltoid, 1.2–1.5 by 0.9–1 mm, subacute, shortly mucronate, sides thinly membranous, pale reddish brown, margins whitish-hyaline, keel subacute, greenish. Stamens 1–2; anthers 0.2–0.3 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets obovate to obovate-orbicular, biconvex, 0.5–0.7 by 0.4–0.5 mm, shiny yellowish brown, smooth.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Annual or short-lived perennial. Culms solitary or tufted, 7–50 cm by 0.3–2 mm, trigonous to subterete, smooth. Leaves basal; blade linear, 3–30(–40) cm by 0.8–3 mm, acute, flattish, margins weakly incurved, glabrous to pubescent; sheath 1–15 cm long, pale brown to cinnamon brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2–5, leaf-like, the longest 1–22 cm long. Inflorescence simple to compound, 1.5–15 by 2–10 cm; primary branches (1–)2–7, rather rigid, 1.2–17 cm long. Spikelets 3-many per inflorescence, solitary or in finger like clusters of 2–8, linear-cylindric to narrowly conical-cylindric, terete, 7–22 by 1.2–2 mm. Glumes 8–35 per spikelet, spirally imbricate, lanceolate, 3.5–4.2 by 1.2–1.7 mm, acute, mucronate to shortly awned, sides chartaceous, glabrous, glaucous to pale brown, keel obtuse, 3-nerved, greenish. Stamens 2; anthers 1.5 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets obovate, biconvex, 1–1.3 by 0.6–0.8 mm, pale brown, with ca 12 longitudinal rows of transversely oblong epidermal cells, sparsely verruculose.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms densely tufted, 20–60 cm by 0.5–2 mm, ± trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal, many; blade linear, often somewhat falcate, 5–18 cm by 1–4 mm, rounded, coriaceous, flattish, margins incurved; sheath 1–2 cm long, pale greenish; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2–3, subulate, erect, the longest shorter than inflorescence, 0.5–1.5 cm long. Inflorescence simple, rarely compound, 3–10 by 3–5 cm; primary branches 2–6, 1–8 cm long. Spikelets (2–)4–18 per inflorescence, oblong-conical to cylindric, terete, 12–20 by 2–4 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally imbricate, ovate, 4–7 by 2.5–4 mm, obtuse, shortly cuspidate, sides chartaceous, orange brown, slightly shiny, margins narrowly pale-hyaline, keel obtuse, 1-nerved, yellowish. Stamens 3; anthers 1.5–2 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly obovoid to obovoid-pyriform, trigonous, 1–1.3 by 0.8–1 mm, apex-truncate, deeply furrowed on each side, indistinctly cancellate, sometimes verruculose.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Annual or short-lived perennial. Culms densely tufted, wiry, 15–28 cm by 0.5–1 mm, subterete to trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal; blade filiform, 7–15 cm by 0.2–0.3 mm, acute, canaliculate, glabrous; sheath 0.7–4 cin long, cinnamon or rusty brown, apex obliquely truncate. Involucral bracts 2–5, the longest 2–3 exceeding inflorescence, 7–11 cm long. Inflorescence capitate, ± penicillate, 1–3 by 0.8–2.5 mm. Spikelets 6–15 per inflorescence, linear-cylindric, suberect to erect-patent, ± angular, 13–33 by 1 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally imbricate, erect, lanceolate 3–3.2 by 0.9–1.2 mm, acute with awn ca 0.5 mm long, sides scarious, ± nerveless, yellowish brown to rusty brown, margins narrowly hyaline, keel acute, green. Stamens 2; anthers 0.2–0.3 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets narrowly obovate, biconvex, 0.7–0.8 by 0.3–0.4 mm, brown, with 5–7 indistinct longitudinal rows of ininute, transversely linear epidermal cells.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Annual. Culms ± tufted, 6–20 cm by 0.2–0.5 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal, much shorter than culm; blade narrowly linear, 2–10 cm by 0.5–1 mm, acute, flattish, glabrous, sheath up to 1 cm long, pale brown to pale cinnamon brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2–3, leaf-like to setaceous, the longest 0.4–1.6 cm long. Inflorescence a ± finger-like cluster of 2–9 spikelets, 1–3 by 2–4 cm, rarely a single spikelet or with a single branch supporting a second cluster of spikelets. Spikelets linear-cylindric, terete, 5–12 by 1–1.2 mm. Glumes 6–24 per spikelet, spirally imbricate, ovate to ovate-deltoid, 2.5–3 by 1.6–2 mm, subobtuse, muticous, sides thinly chartaceous, glabrous, shiny chestnut brown, margins broadly pale-hyaline, keel obtuse, 3-nerved. Stamens 2–3; anthers 0.5 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets broadly obovate, biconvex, 0.7–0.9 by 0.5–0.6 mm, brownish, sparsely verruculose, finely trabeculate with ca 10 rows of transversely oblong epidermal cells, verruculose.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms tufted, 15–60 cm by 0.2–1.5 mm, trigonous, smooth to scabrid. Leaves basal, few; blade filiform, 10–30 cm by 0.3–0.5 mm, obtuse, margins ± incurved; sheath 1.5–4 cm long, pale-hyaline to mid-brown, apex oblique; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 1–3, glume-like or setaceous, the longest 5–20 mm long. Inflorescence simple or capitate, 5–20 mm by 5–8 mm; primary branches (when present) up to 2 cm long. Spikelets 3–12 per inflorescence, in clusters of 2–8, ellipsoid, 2.2–3.5 by 1.5–2 mm. Glumes 10–15 per spikelet, spirally imbricate, broadly ovate, 1–1.5 by 0.7–1.3 mm, rounded-truncate or shallowly emarginate, mucronulate, sides membranous, brown, densely gland-dotted, margins pale-hyaline, fimbriate-ciliate above, keel obtuse, 3 nerved, pale brown. Stamens 1–2; anthers 0.5 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets obovoid, trigonous, 0.7–0.9 by 0.5–0.7 mm, cream, verruculose.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Annual. Culms tufted, (5–)15–40 cm by 0.5–1 mm, trigonous, smooth, often puberulent below inflorescence. Leaves basal; blade linear, 2.5–6 cm by 1–2 mm, obtuse, flat, glabrescent or pubescent on lower surface; sheath up to 6 cm long, light brown, apex truncate; ligule a fringe of short hairs. Involucral bracts 1–3, the longest leaf-like or rarely setaceous, (0.3–)0.6–1.5 cm long, less than ½ as long as inflorescence. Inflorescence simple to compound, rarely a single spikelet, open, 2–6(–10) cm by 2–6 cm; primary branches 2–8, 1–5(–8) cm long. Spikelets (1–)2–20 per inflorescence, solitary, ovoid to ovoid-cylindric, 3–6 by 1.5–2 mm. Glumes 7–28 per spikelet, spirally arranged, broadly ovate, 1.2–1.8 1.2–1.5 mm, subobtuse to subacute, sides thinly chartaceous, shiny reddish brown, margins broadly hyaline, keel obtuse, 3-nerved, greenish. Stamens 1(–2); anther 0.3–0.5 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets broadly obovate, biconvex, 0.6–0.8(–0.9) by 0.5–0.6 mm, cream to pale brown, with 5(–9) rows of transversely oblong epidermal cells.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Annual or short-lived perennial. Culms arising from leaf axils, several, 10–60(–90) cm by 1–3 mm, 4-sided, smooth. Leaves basal, or cauline reduced to bladeless sheaths; blade linear, 10–50 cm by 1–4 mm, subacute, bilaterally flattened; basal sheaths 1–18 cm long, open, cauline sheaths tubular, 2–10 cm long; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2–4, setaceous, the longest 1–3 cm long. Inflorescence compound to decompound, open, 3–10 by 3–10 cm; primary branches 3–7, 1–7 cm long. Spikelets many per inflorescence, ovoid-globose to globose, 1.5–3(–5) by 1–2.1 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally arranged, broadly ovate, 1–1.2 by 0.6–0.8 mm, obtuse, sides membranous, reddish brown, margins broadly hyaline, keel obtuse, yellowish, obscurely 3-nerved. Stamens 1(–2); anthers 0.6 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets obovoid, trigonous, 0.6–0.8 by 0.3–0.5 mm, creamy yellow, sparsely verruculose especially on angles, cancellate with 5–7 longitudinal rows of transversely linear-oblong cells.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Rhizomatous perennial; rhizome woody, covered with fibrous leaf sheath remnants. Culms solitary, 11–25 cm by 1.2–1.5 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal, as long as or longer than culm; blade linear, 9–19 cm by 1.5–2.5 mm, subacute, flattish, margins slightly inrolled; sheath 2–5 cm long, light to dark brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2–5, leaf-like, the longest 3–4 cm long. Inflorescence simple to compound, 2.5–3.5 cm by 1.5–3 cm, crowded; primary branches 2–5, up to 2.5 cm long. Spikelets (3–)5–23 per inflorescence, solitary or in clusters of 2–3, oblong-cylindric, terete, 8–12 by 2–3 mm. Glumes 30–60 per spikelet, spirally imbricate, ovate-lanceolate to ovate, 2.8–3.5 by 1.8–2.2 mm, acute, mucronate, sides thinly membranous, 5-nerved, mid-brown below keel, margins broadly white-hyaline, keel obtuse to subacute, 2-nerved, greenish. Stamens 2; anthers ca 0.4 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets narrowly pyriform, thickly biconvex, 1–1.2 by 0.6–0.7 mm, brown, ± shiny, smooth.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms 20–75 cm by 0.5–1.5 mm, subterete to trigonous above, smooth. Leaves reduced to basal sheaths; sheaths cylindric, 1–12 cm long, light green to pale brownish, apex obliquely truncate; ligule 0. Involucral bract 1, glume like. Inflorescence a single terminal spikelet, erect at first, soon becoming patent to ± horizontal. Spikelet ovoid to ovoid-ellipsoid, terete, 8–16 by 4–6 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally imbricate, broadly ovate to oval, 4–5 by 2.5–3 mm, rounded, mucronate, sides membranous to thinly chartaceous, mid-brown, striate with dark brown below keel, margins broadly pale-hyaline, keel flattish to obtuse, indistinctly 4–5-nerved, yellowish brown. Stamens 3; anthers 2 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets broadly obovate, unequally biconvex, 1.25–1.5 by 0.8–1 mm, maturing cream or slightly brownish, coarsely transversely wrinkled.

description: Annual. Culms tufted, filiform, 5–15 cm by 0.3–0.5 mm. Leaves basal, rosette-forming; blade broadly linear, falcate, twisted, 3–7 cm by 1.5–2.5 mm, obtuse, flattish, sheath up to 0.8 cm long, rusty brown to yellowish brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2–3, glume-like to shortly setaceous, 2–3 mm long. Inflorescence simple; primary branches 1–3, 5–10 mm long. Spikelets (1–)3–6 per inflorescence, lanceolate, angular, 5–8 by 1.2–1.5 mm. Glumes 4–14 per spikelet, 2-ranked below, spirally arranged above, broadly ovate, 1.4–1.5 by 1.4–1.5 mm, sides membranous, rusty brown, margins hyaline, keel obtuse, 3-nerved, green. Stamen 1; anther 0.5 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets obovate-orbicular, trigonous, 0.6–0.8 by 0.5–0.6 mm, whitish or yellowish brown, densely verruculose, obscurely reticulate.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms 1-few, 6–40 cm by 0.3–0.8 mm, trigonous, smooth below, spinulose-scabrous above. Leaves basal; blade narrowly linear, up to 30 cm by 0.5–1.2 mm, flattish with weakly incurved margins or weakly inrolled; sheath 1–6 cm long, dorsally pale green to pale brown, ventrally whitish-hyaline; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2–3, glume-like or with setaceous blade 0.5–1 cm long. Inflorescence of 1(–3) spikelets, upper one with a 1–2 cm long peduncle. Spikelets ovate, ovate-lanceolate, somewhat flattened, 8–15 by 3–7 mm. Glumes 8–20 per spikelet, 2-ranked below, spirally arranged above, ovate to broadly ovate, 3–6 by 2–4 mm, acute, mucronate, sides chartaceous, whitish to pale yellowish, weakly shiny, keel acute, slightly incurved, 3-nerved, greenish. Stamens 3; anthers 2 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly obovoid, trigonous, 2–2.5 by 1.3–1.5 mm, white or cream, ± densely verruculose.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms tufted, 25–45 cm by 0.3–0.6 mm, trigonous, smooth, glabrous. Leaves basal; blade narrowly linear, 5–20 cm by 0.5–1 mm, abruptly acute, canaliculate; sheath 1–6 cm long, yellowish brown, apex obliquely truncate; ligule a dense fringe of hairs. Involucral bracts 2, leaf-like, the longest 1–7 cm long. Inflorescence compound to decompound, 3–6 by 1.5–3.5 cm; primary branches up to 5, 2–4 cm long. Spikelets 7–15(–23) per inflorescence, solitary, ovoid-ellipsoid to oblong ellipsoid, terete, 4–8 by 1.5–2 mm. Glumes 20–40 per spikelet, spirally imbricate, broadly ovate to ovate-elliptic, 1.5–1.8 by 1.2–1.3 mm, acute, sides membranous, 3–5 nerved, brown, margins broad-scarious, keel obtuse, 3-nerved. Stamens 2–3; anthers 1–1.2 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets obovate to broadly obovate, biconvex, 0.6–0.7 by 0.5.–0.6 mm, maturing brown, sparsely verruculose especially near angles, shallowly cancellate with 14–17 longitudinal rows of transversely oblong-hexagonal epidermal cells.

description: Perennial. Culms densely tufted, (5–)10–30 cm by 0.3–0.5 mm, wiry, smooth. Leaves mostly reduced to bladeless sheaths, or upper 1–2 with a filiforin blade up to 6 cm long; sheaths up to 5 cm long, rusty or cinnamon brown, apex truncate; ligule 0. Involucral bracts glume-like, ± as long as spikelet. Inflorescence a single, terminal spikelet. Spikelet linear-cylindric to narrowly obconical, terete, 3–6 by 1 mm. Glumes 4–9 per spikelet, spirally arranged, lanceolate, 2.5–3 by 1.5 mm, sides somewhat cartilaginous whitish to pale green brown, keel obtuse, faintly 3–5-nerved, greenish. Stamens 1–2(–3); anthers 1.3–2 mm long. Stigmas (2–)3. Nutlets obovate to obovoid, biconvex to trigonous, 0.8–0.9 by 0.5–0.6 mm, yellowish brown, verruculose with irregular epidermal cells.

description: Annual. Culms ± densely tufted, 10–22 cm by 0.3–0.5 mm, smooth. Leaves basal; blade linear, ± falcate, 3–10 cm by 1.5–2.5 mm, shortly acuminate, flat; sheath up to 1 cm long, pale yellowish brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2–3, setaceous, the longest 9–12 mm long, dilated at base. Inflorescence simple, 1.5–5 by 0.7–3 cm; primary branches 1–5, 1–3.5 cm long. Spikelets 2–8 per inflorescence, lanceolate, subterete, 5–9 by 2–2.2 mm. Glumes 10–15 per spikelet, 2-ranked below, spirally arranged above, broadly ovate, 2.8–3.3 by 2.3–2.5 mm, acute, mucronate, sides chartaceous, pale brown with dark brown band near margins, the margins narrowly pale-hyaline, keel obtuse. Stamens 3; anthers 0.8 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly obovoid, trigonous, 0.7–0.8 by 0.7 mm, rounded, whitish grey, coarsely tuberculate.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Short-lived perennial. Culms 5–30 cm by 0.3–0.5 mm, subterete to trigonous, smooth, glabrous. Leaves basal; blade filiform, up to 4 cm by 0.2–0.5 mm, obtuse, shallowly canaliculate, often reduced to bladeless sheath; sheath 1–4 cm long, yellowish brown, apex obliquely truncate; ligule 0. Involucral bract 1, glume-like or setaceous, 0.3–2.5 cm long. Inflorescence a single, terminal spikelet. Spikelets ellipsoid to oblong-ovoid 5–9 by 2.5–3.5 mm, obtuse. Stamens 1–2; anther 0.7–1 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets obovate, biconvex, 0.8–1 by ca 0.5 mm, maturing brown to greyish purple, minutely cancellate with 15–20 longitudinal rows of transversely linear epidermal cells, often verruculose above.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms 11.5–15 cm by 0.3–0.5 mm, ± terete with longitudinal ridges, smooth, glabrous. Leaves basal; blade linear, 2–6 cm by 1.4–1.7 mm, acute, flat, somewhat falcate; sheath 0.9–1.1 cm long, pale brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts setaceous, longest 0.5–2 mm long. Inflorescence simple to compound, 3.3–5 by 1.4–5 cm; primary branches 3–5, 1–3.5 cm long. Spikelets solitary, narrowly oblong to narrowly lanceolate, ± flattened, 5.7–10 by 1.1–1.7 mm. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly obovoid, 0.7–0.8 by 0.5–0.6 mm, broadly obtuse to rounded, mid-brown, papillose-rugose.

description: Perennial. Culms ± tufted, 15–25 cm by 0.7–1 mm, angular, smooth. Leaves basal; blade narrowly linear, (4–)10–20 cm by 1–1.5 mm, abruptly acute, flattish, sparsely puberulent; sheath 2–6 cm long, rusty brown, sparsely pubescent; ligule 0. description: Rhizomatous perennial; rhizome short, woody, covered with fibrous leaf sheath remnants. Culm usually solitary, 15–50 cm by 0.5–1.2 mm, trigonous, smooth, often sparsely hairy above. Leaves basal; blade linear, 4–20 cm by 2–3.5 mm, acute, shortly apiculate, flat margins weakly incurved, glaucous; sheath 3–7 cm long, pale to mid brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 3–5, the longest leaf-like, 1.5–4 cm long. Inflorescence simple to compound, rarely decompound, 2–5 by 2–3 cm; primary branches 3–6, up to 4 cm long. Spikelets 5–20 per inflorescence, solitary or in pairs, broadly ovoid to ovoid ellipsoid, 5–8(–12) by 3–4 mm. Stamens 3; anthers 1.7–2 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets obovate-orbicular, biconvex, 1–1.5 by 0.8–1.2 mm, greyish brown, verruculose, with 25–30 fine longitudinal rows of epidermal cells.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms crowded along rhizome, 30–80 cm by 1–3 mm, acutely 4–5-angled, smooth. Leaves reduced to bladeless sheaths; sheath 1–17 cm long, apex lanceolate, dusky or cinnamon brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2–5, setaceous with lanceolate base, longest up to 1.5 cm long. Inflorescence compound to decompound, open, 2–6 by 2–6 cm; primary branches 6–8, up to 5 cm long. Spikelets ovoid to ovoid-ellipsoid, 3–5 by 2 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally arranged, ovate, 2–2.3 by 1.5 mm, obtuse, sides membranous, mid-brown, margins hyaline, keel obtuse, 1-nerved, paler brown. Stamens (2–)3; anthers 0.7–1 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly obovoid, trigonous, 0.8–1 by 0.6–0.8 mm, whitish to yellowish brown, smooth to sparsely verruculose, with 9–14 longitudinal rows of epidermal cells on each side.

description: Rhizomatous perennial; rhizome woody, covered with fibrous leaf sheath remnants. Culms tufted, 20–40 cm by 0.7–1 mm, rigid, smooth to ± pubescent below, punctulate. Leaves basal; blade setaceous, 8–22 cm by 1 mm, abruptly acuminate, canaliculate, densely pubescent; sheath up to 5 cm long, cinnamon brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 3–5, setacaous, pubescent, the longest 2–7 cm long, exceeding inflorescence. Inflorescence simple, rarely compound, 1–2.5 by 1–2 cm; primary branches 3–6, up to 1.5 cm long. Spikelets up to 15 per inflorescence usually in clusters in 2–6, lanceolate, flattened, 4–5 by 2 mm. Glumes 2–4 per spikelet, 2–4-ranked, ovate, 4–4.5 by 2 mm, acute to acuminate, muticous, sides thinly membranous, dark brown, densely gland-dotted, keel acute, 1-nerved. Stamens 3; anthers ca 2 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets obovoid, trigonous, 1 by 0.7 mm, maturing pale yellowish brown, densely verruculose, sparsely minutely punctate.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms tufted, 5–50 cm by 0.3–0.8 mm, smooth. Leaves basal; blade narrowly linear to ± filiform, 2–16 cm by 0.5–1 mm, flattish or with inrolled margins; sheath 2–6 cm long, cinnamon brown, apex obliquely truncate, ciliolate; ligule a fringe of dense short hairs. Involucral bracts 1–2, glume-like, rarely with short setaceous blade. Inflorescence usually a solitary spikelet sometimes simple; primary branches (when present) 1–2, 1–3 cm long. Spikelets 1–2(–3) per inflorescence, ovoid to ellipsoid, 5–10 by 3–4 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, ovate-orbicular, 2.5–3.2 by 2–3 mm, broadly obtuse to rounded, shortly mucronate, sides thinly chartaceous, 5–7 nerved, pale to orange brown, slightly shiny, keel rounded. Stamens 2; anthers 0.5 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets obovate-orbicular, biconvex, 1.1–1.3 by 1–1.2 mm, ± rounded, maturing yellowish white, smooth with minute isodiametric epidermal cells.

description: Rhizomatous perennial; rhizome long-creeping. Culms erect, (10–)30–60 cm by 1.2–2.5 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal, many; blade linear, 4–10 cm by 1.7–4 mm. obtuse, margins inrolled, glaucous, with appressed silky hairs on the lower surface; sheath 2–3 cm long, pale green to dark rusty brown, apex obliquely truncate; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2–3, leaf-like, the longest up to 2 cm long. Inflorescence simple to compound, 3–10 cm by 3–4 cm; primary branches 2–6, 1–8 cm long. Spikelets few-many per inflorescence, in clusters of 3–10, ovoid to oblong-ovoid, terete, 6–12 by 2.5–4 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally arranged, ovate to broadly ovate, 2.5–4 by 2–3 mm, subacute to subobtuse, mucronate, sides herbaceous, brownish grey, shortly pubescent, margins whitish-hyaline, keel obtuse, brown. Stamens 2–3; anthers 1.5 mm long. Stigmas 2–3. Nutlets obovate, biconvex, 1–1.5 by 0.8–1 mm, maturing purplish or dark brown, ± smooth to minutely dotted.

description: Perennial. Culms tufted, 6–16 cm by 0.3–0.4 mm, terete, smooth. Leaves basal; blade linear, 5–7.5 cm by 0.5–1.2 mm, obtuse, shallowly concave; sheath 0.7–1.2 cm long, pale brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2, the longest setaceous to filiform 0.5–1 cm long. Inflorescence simple to compound, 1.5–3.5 by 0.8–2 cm; primary branches 0.7–2.3 mm long. Spikelets 4–8 per inflorescence, usually solitary, elliptic to ovate-elliptic, flattened, 5–6 by 1.8–2.1 mm. Glumes up to 10 per spikelet, 2-ranked, ovate, 2.5–3.5 by 1.8–2 mm, acute, sides chestnut brown, pubescent above. Stamens 3; anthers 0.6–1 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets obovoid, trigonous, 0.8 by 0.6 mm, pale brown, minutely reticulate, tuberculate.

description: Annual. Culms tufted, filiform, 8–20 cm by 0.25–0.5 mm, 3–4-angled, smooth to scabrid on upper angles. Leaves basal; blade linear, 2–7 cm by 0.8–1.2 mm, obtuse, flattish-canaliculate; sheath 5–10 mm long, cinnamon brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 0. Inflorescence a solitary terminal, erect spikelet. Spikelet elliptic or elliptic-lanceolate, strongly flattened, sometimes twisted at the middle, 10–12 by 2.5–4 mm. Glumes 10–28 per spikelet, 2-ranked, lanceolate, 4–6.2 by 2–2.2 mm, acute, sides chartaceous, pale golden brown, margins narrowly hyaline, keel acute, 1-nerved, pale brown. Stamens 3; anthers 2–2.2 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets obovoid, trigonous, sides convex, 1–1.3 by 0.5–0.6 mm, mucronate, maturing white, densely papillose.

description: Perennial. Culms loosely tufted, 10–25 cm by 1–1.3 mm, obtusely angular, glabrous, smooth. Leaves basal; blade narrowly linear, (2–)4–8 cm by 0.7–1 mm, acute, margins inrolled; sheath 3–5 cm long, rusty brown, glabrous; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2–3, setaceous, suberect, the longest 2–9 cm long. Inflorescence narrow, suberect, spike like, 6–15 by 0.5–2.5 cm, branches 2–3, each elongated with 3–8 erect, spicately arranged spikelets, the internodes 0.5–2 cm long. Spikelets 8–20 per inflorescence, solitary, linear-cylindric, ± 4-angled, 1–1.5 cm by 1 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally imbricate, elliptic to oblong-ovate, 2–2.5 by 1–1.3 mm, acute, mucronate, sides thinly membranous, rusty brown, margins pale-hyaline, keel acute. Stamens (2–13; anthers 0.3 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets obovate-elliptic, biconvex, 0.7–0.8 by 0.4–0.5 mm, yellowish brown, smooth to obscurely reticulate.

description: Annual. Culms 5–22 cm by 0.2–0.5 mm, 4–5-angled, smooth. Leaves basal; blade linear, strongly falcate, 1.5–10 cm by 0.5–2.3 mm, obtuse, minutely cuspidate, flattish, margins weakly incurved; sheath up to 0.7 cm, yellowish brown; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2–4, setaceous, the longest 3–10 mm long. Inflorescence simple to compound, open, up to 4 by 4 cm; primary branches 1–5, 7–30 mm long, glabrous to very sparsely hispid. Spikelets (1–)3–15 per inflorescence, lanceolate to elliptic-lanceolate, strongly flattened, 5–8 by 1–2 mm. Glumes 5–14 per spikelet, 2-ranked, ovate to ovate-lanceolate, 2–3.3 by 1–1.6 mm, acute, recurved-mucronate, sides membranous, brown, pubescent above, margins very narrowly hyaline, keel subacute, greenish. Stamens 2–3; anthers 0.7–0.8 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets obovoid, trigonous, 0.7–0.8 by 0.5–0.6 mm, rounded-truncate, base narrowly stipitate, ± acute, whitish to cream, papillose-rugose.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms in series along rhizome, 50–65 cm by 1 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves arising along lower part of culm; blade filiform 10–35 cm by 0.5–0.8 mm, acute, rigid, margins inrolled; sheath up to 10 cm long, greenish to brownish; ligule very shortly membranous. Involucral bracts glume-like. Inflorescence a single terminal spikelet. Spikelet ellipsoid to ellipsoid-cylindric, terete, 1.5–3.5 cm by 4–5 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally arranged, ovate, 6–7 by 4.5–5 min, subobtuse, muticous to mucronulate, sides chartaceous, 7–10-nerved, mid-brown, margins broad, hyaline, dark brown, keel rounded. Stamens 3; anthers 2.5–3 mm long. Stigmas 2; ovary with membranous wings on upper half. Nutlets obovate-elliptic, biconvex, 2–2.3 by 1.3 mm, apex emarginate, maturing mid-brown, ± smooth.

description: Annual. Culms densely tufted, 8–30 cm by 0.25–0.4 mm, angular, smooth. Leaves basal; blade 3–17 cm by 0.3–0.7 mm, subacute, flat, glabrous to sparsely hispid above; sheath tubular, 1–2 cm long, pale greenish to pale reddish brown; ligule 0. Involucral bract 1, glume-like or setaceous, the longest up to 0.8 cm long. Inflorescence a single terminal spikelet. Spikelet ovate-lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, terete, 5–12 by 1.5–2.2 mm, acute. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally imbricate, narrowly ovoid to oblong conical, 2.2–3 mm by 1.2–1.5 mm, acute or subacute, shortly cuspidate, sides scarious, pale reddish brown, margins rather broadly hyaline, keel obtuse, 3-nerved. Stamen 1; anther 0.5–0.8 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets broadly obovate, biconvex, 0.7–0.9 by 0.6–0.8 mm, cream to pale yellowish brown, finely trabeculate with 15–21 longitudinal rows of transversely oblong epidermal cells, usually sparsely verruculose.

description: Perennial. Culms densely tufted, 10–60 cm by 0.8–1.3 mm, sharply 4-angled, smooth. Leaves reduced to bladeless sheaths; sheaths 1–15 cm long, pale greenish above yellowish brown below, apex obliquely truncate, broadly hyaline; ligule 0. Inflorescence a single, terminal spikelet. Involucral bract glume-like, inconspicuous. Spikelet broadly ellipsoid to ovoid-ellipsoid, terete, 5–12 by 4–6 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally imbricate, oblong-elliptic, incurved, 3–4.5 by 1.2–1.5 mm, rounded, sides membranous, finely many-veined, yellowish brown and often tinged darker brown below keel, keel broad, 3-nerved. Stamen 1; anther 1–1.5 mm long. Stigmas 2–3. Nutlets linear-oblong to oblong, biconvex, 1.5–1.7 by 0.3–0.4 mm, cream, cancellate with 5–8 longitudinal rows of transversely oblong-hexagonal epidermal cells.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms 1-several, 20–80 cm by 0.7–2 mm, flattened-trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal, 2-ranked; blade linear, up to 40 cm by 2–5 mm, abruptly acuminate, flattish; sheath up to 5 cm long, truncate, pale green to rusty brown; ligule a dense fringe of short hairs. Involucral bracts 2–4, the longest suberect, 1–8 cm long. Inflorescence compound, rather open, 5–12 by 4–8 cm; primary branches 2–5, 0.7–9 cm long. Spikelets oblong-ovoid to ovoid-lanceolate, angular, 5–8 by 2–3 mm. Glumes 6–17 per spikelet, spirally arranged, ovate, 3–4 by 2–2.5 mm, acute to mucronate, sides chartaceous, indistinctly 5–7-nerved, chestnut brown, margins membranous, keel acute, green. Stamens 3; anthers 2 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets obovoid, trigonous, 1.2–1.5 by 0.7–1 mm, whitish yellow, cancellate with several rows of hexagonal to transversely oblong epidermal cells and scattered papillae towards apex.

description: Annual. Culms tufted, setaceous 4–12 cm by 0.3–0.5 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal; blade setaceous, 2–8 cm by 0.5–0.7 mm, abruptly acute, canaliculate; sheath up to 1.5 cm long, obliquely truncate, pale brown; ligule 0. Spikelets 1–4 per inflorescence, lanceolate to elliptic-lanceolate, strongly flattened, 4–5 by 1–1.3 mm. Glumes 3–7 per spikelet, 2-ranked, ovate-elliptic, 2–2.5 by 1.4–1.6 mm, subacute, muticous or mucronate, sides membranous, brown or rusty brown, densely gland-dotted, keel greenish, 1(–3) nerved. Stamens 3; anthers 0.5–0.7 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets obovoid, trigonous, 0.8–0.9 by 0.5 mm, pale yellowish brown, indistinctly minutely reticulate with isodiametric epidermal cells.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms tufted, 30–70(–100) cm by 1–1.5 mm, angular, smooth to scabrid above. Leaves basal; blade narrowly linear, 7–27 cm by 0.5–1.5 mm, obtuse to shortly acuminate, flattish to canaliculate; sheath up to 15 cm long, yellowish to brown, apex truncate; ligule a fringe of short hairs. Involucral bracts 1–2, leaf-like, the longest suberect, 0.5–3 cm long. Inflorescence a single spikelet or simple to compound, open; primary branches (when present) 0.8–4 cm long. Spikelets (1–)3–10 per inflorescence, solitary, ovoid to ovoid-cylindric, terete, (6–)10–25 by 4–6 mm. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally arranged, broadly ovate, 4–6 by 3–4.5 mm, obtuse, mucronulate, sides chartaceous, indistinctly 7–10-nerved, mid- to chestnut brown, margins scarious, keel obtuse. Stamens 3; anthers 1.8–2.5 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets obovate, biconvex, (1–)1.2–1.5 by 0.8–1 mm, rounded, yellowish brown, smooth, somewhat shiny, with minute isodiametric epidermal cells.

description: Perennial. Culms tufted, 20–80(–120) cm by 1–5 mm, trigonous to subterete, smooth. Leaves cauline reduced to bladeless sheaths, sometimes basal with blade present; blade (when developed) linear, 7–25 cm by 1.5–2 mm, flattish to channelled; sheaths 2–20 cm long, acute, obliquely truncate; ligule 0. Involucral bracts 2–3, narrowly lanceolate, the longest 0.5–1 cm long. Inflorescence simple to compound, 2–10 by 1.5–8 cm; primary branches 2–8, 1–5 cm long. Spikelets 3–40 per inflorescence, broadly ovoid to broadly ellipsoid or globose, 3–8 by 3–4 mm, obtuse. Glumes many per spikelet, spirally arranged, ovate to ovate-elliptic, 1.8–2.5 by 1–1.5 mm, obtuse, sometimes mucronate, sides membranous, yellowish to mid-brown, margins broadly white-hyaline, keel broadly obtuse, greenish. Stamens (2–)3; anthers 0.7 mm long. Stigmas (2–)3. Nutlets obovate or obovoid-orbicular, biconvex to trigonous, 0.7–1 by 0.5–0.7 mm, creamy yellow, cancellate, sparsely verruculose.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms usually solitary, 20–80 cm by 0.5–1 mm, 4–5 angular, smooth. Leaves ± basal; blade narrowly linear, 10–45 cm by 1–2 mm, shortly acuminate, flat or shallowly canaliculate, pubescent; sheath 1.5–7 cm long, dark purplish brown; ligule 0. Glumes 6–8 per spikelet, 2-ranked, 5–5.5 by 1.6–2 mm, acute, shortly mucronate, sides chartaceous, mid- to dark brown, margins narrowly white-hyaline, keel acute, 1-nerved. Stamens 3; anthers 1.5–2 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly obovate, trigonous, 1.2–1.3 by 0.8–1 mm, indistinctly reticulate with isodiametric epidermal cells, densely verruculose.

description: Annual. Culms tufted, 5–50 cm by 1–2 mm, ciliate-pubescent above. Cauline leaves several; blade linear, 5–15 cm by 3–8 mm, abruptly acute, margins pubescent or ciliate; sheath 1–3 cm long, pubescent. Inflorescence with 1–3 clusters of spikelets; peduncles short, ciliate-pubescent. Spikelets ovate or oblong-elliptic, 4–7 by 3 mm, subacute, squarrose, greyish green. Glumes obovate to obovate-oblong or elliptic, 1.5–1.7 by 1.25 mm, acute or obtuse, thinly membranous, shortly pubescent outside with pilose centre, awn ca 1 mm long, ciliate. Perianth segments 6; outer whorl of bristles occasionally much reduced, smooth to scabrid; inner whorl of oblong or ± square blades, 3-toothed, base long-stipitate. Anthers 0.25 mm long. Nutlets obovoid to ellipsoid, 0.8–1 by 0.5–0.6 mm, smooth to obscurely wrinkled.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms 3–100 cm by 6–9 mm, pubescent below inflorescence. Cauline leaves 5–7; blade lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, 10–20 cm by 5–25 mm, acute, ciliate at base; sheath 2–5 cm long, usually glabrous. Inflorescence with 3–12 clusters of spikelets, peduncles whitish villous. Spikelets ovoid or ovoid-ellipsoid, ± squarrose, 4–10 by 2.5–3 mm, acute, brownish-green or dark brownish green. Glumes obovate to ovate-elliptic, 2–2.5 by 1.2–1.5 mm, rounded, shortly pubescent, awn 0.8–1 mm long, often pilose. Perianth segments 3, in 1 whorl only, obovate or oblong, membranous, truncate, subsessile with a very short claw at base. Anthers 0.5–0.7 mm long. Nutlets obovoid to ellipsoid, 0.8–1.2 by 0.6–0.7 mm, shiny, smooth to obscurely wrinkled.

description: Perennial. Culms densely tufted, 50–100 by 2–5 cm, subterete to trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal and cauline; blade rigid, up to 50 cm by 3–7 mm, caudate-acuminate, coriaceous, margins strongly inrolled; cauline sheaths 7–15 cm long, yellowish brown, basal sheaths up to 30 cm long, dark or chestnut brown. Involucral bracts several, leaf like, the lowest up to 30 cm long; sheath up to 3 cm long. Inflorescence paniculate, resembling a spike, ± cylindric to linear-oblong, 15–50 by 3–7 cm with 10–28 ± sessile partial inflorescences each 1–5 by 1.2–1.7 mm. Spikelets numerous, densely clustered, oblong, becoming turbinate in nutlet, 7–10 mm long, 6–8-glumed, 1-flowered. Glumes ovate-lanceolate, 10–12 mm long, long-acuminate, sides chartaceous, dark brown, upper 2–3 glumes broadly ovate, much shorter, ciliolate, obtuse to rounded. Perianth segments 0. Stamens 3–4; anthers 3–4 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets ellipsoid, trigonous, 4.5 by 2 mm, conical, dark brown to shiny black, smooth.

description: Rhizomatous. Culms central, 35–90 cm by 1–3 mm, trigonous, smooth to scabrid. Leaves mostly basal, 1–2 cauline; blade linear. 6–130 cm by 10–23 mm, apex and base gradually narrowed, 3-nerved; pseudopetiole absent; basal sheaths 2–15 cm long, reddish brown to purple, cauline sheaths light purple or cinnamon brown. Involucral bracts 2–3, leaf-like, 10–40 cm long. Inflorescence an open panicle, hemispherical or broadly ovoid, 2–7 by 3–10 cm, comprising up to 10 primary peduncles each subtending up to 6 secondary peduncles terminating in 1–3 sessile or shortly stalked spikes. Spikes ± elliptic-globose, 3–7 by 2.5–6 mm, light to mid-brown. Spicoid bracts ovate-orbicular to elliptic 1.3–2.5 by 1.2–2 mm, apex rounded. Spicoid ± equalling the spicoid bracts. Floral bracts 2, free or ± connate on abaxial side, 1.2–1.8 mm long, keel ciliate. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly ovoid, 1.8–3 by 1.3–1.5 mm, apex conical, irregularly 2–5-ridged.

description: Perennial. Rhizome short. Culms densely tufted, 8–20 cm by 0.25–0.5 mm, trigonous, sparsely scabrid. Leaves basal; blade canaliculate, 4–11 cm by 0.5–0.9 mm, long acuminate, sparingly scabrid; sheath 0.5–2.5 cm long, pale, the outer ones fulvous to brown. Involucral bracts setaceous, 1–3.5 cm long. description: Rhizomatous perennial; rhizome slender, long-creeping. Culms rather distant in series along rhizome, 7–30 cm by 1–1.5 mm, triquetrous, smooth. description: Rhizome less obviously horizontally creeping. Culms 18–70 cm by 1–2 mm. Leaves: blade on upper 2–4 sheaths linear, flat, 10–25 cm by 3–5 mm, gradually narrowed, acute, flat. Spikelets 3–many, spreading, oblong to oblong-lanceolate, 3–10 by 1.5–2.5 mm, flattened; axis ± straight. Glumes ovate to ovate-elliptic, 1–1.8 by 1–1.3 mm, rounded-truncate to emarginate, mucronate, sides translucent, nerves 0, pale greenish or brownish, keel acute, 3–5-nerved, green to reddish brown. Stamens 2; anthers 0.3 mm long. Nutlets elliptic to elliptic-lanceolate, 0.5–0.8 by 0.3–0.5 mm, maturing brownish, minutely punctate.

description: Annual or short-lived perennial. Culms tufted, 10–60 cm by 0.7–2 mm, trigonous, smooth, lower part with several nodes. Leaves: blade linear, 4–11 cm by 2–4 mm, acuminate, flattish-plicate; sheath 1–3 cm long, pale green to reddish brown. Involucral bracts 3–5, the longest 10–15 cm long. Inflorescence capitate or simple; primary branches 2–5, 1–4 cm long. Spikes ovoid, 0.9–2 by 1–2 cm; axis 1–4 mm long. Spikelets 3–17, narrowly ovate or oblong-lanceolate, 7–20 by 2–3.5 mm; axis straight. Glumes ovate or broadly ovate, 2–2.5 by 1.5–2 mm, obtuse, sides membranous, nerves 0, pale brown to reddish or purple brown, keel rather broad, often distinctly furrowed on both sides of keel, 3–5-nerved, green. Stamens 3; anthers 0.7–1 mm long. Nutlets broadly obovate, 1–1.3 by 0.8–1 mm, maturing black, minutely punctate.

description: Slender annual. Culms tufted, 8–35 cm by 0.5–1 mm, often weakly curved, trigonous, smooth. Leaves: blade narrowly linear, 4–20 cm by 0.7–1 mm, long-acuminate, canaliculate; sheath up to 5 cm long, reddish purple or reddish brown. Involucral bracts 1–3, the longest suberect, up to 10 cm long. Inflorescence usually of 1 spike, rarely simple; primary branches 1–3, up to 1 cm long. Spikes 1.5–4.5 by 1–3.5 cm; axis 1–4 min long. Spikelets 5–16 per spike, erect-patent to ± erect, oblong-lanceolate to linear-oblong, flattened, 8–35 by 1.8–2.2 mm; axis straight. Glumes ovate, 2 by 1.2–1.5 mm, acute, mucronulate, sides membranous, nerves 0, pale yellowish to golden yellow, margins whitish-hyaline, keel acute, 3-nerved, greenish. Stamens 2; anthers 0.5 mm long. Nutlets orbicular-obovate or broadly elliptic, 0.8–1 by 0.6–0.7 mm, maturing purplish brown or blackish, finely transversely undulate-rugulose.

description: Annual. Culms tufted, 5–38 cm by 0.5–1 mm, trigonous to triquetrous above, smooth. Leaves: blade narrowly linear, 1.8–6 cm by 0.5–2 mm, shortly acuminate, flattish-plicate; sheath up to 4 cm long, reddish to brownish purple. Involucral bracts 3–4, the lowest up to 15 cm long. Inflorescence simple, open to congested, 1–7 by 1.7 cm; primary branches 2–6, up to 7 cm long. Spikes ovoid-globose, 1.5–2 by 2–3 cm; axis up to 5 mm long. Spikelets spreading, linear to linear-lanceolate, 10–35 by 1–1.5 mm, flattened; axis zigzag. Glumes oblong-obovate to obovate, 1.5–1.8 by 1–1.3 mm, broadly obtuse to ± rounded, sides membranous, nerves 0, pale to mid-golden brown, margins rather broadly hyaline, keel acute, 3-nerved, greenish. Stamen 1; anther 0.3 mm long. Nutlets oblong to ± oblong-obovate, 1.2–1.3 by 0.5 mm, brown, shallowly furrowed on each side, minutely punctate.

description: Short-lived perennial. Culms 1-few, 35–90 cm by 1–2 mm triquetrous, smooth, often scabrid above. Leaves: blade linear, 12–43 cm by 2–4 mm, acute, flattish-plicate; sheath 2–21 cm long, mid-brown to reddish brown. Involucral bracts 2–4, the longest 10–20 cm long. Inflorescence simple, open or congested; primary branches 1–4(–6), up to 6 cm long. Spikes broadly ovoid-ellipsoid, 2–3 by 2–3 cm; axis 0.2–1 cm long. Spikelets 3–12 per spike, patent to spreading, lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate, 8–20 by 3.5–5 mm; axis straight. Glumes ovate-lanceolate to ovate-elliptic, 3.8–4 by 2.5–3 mm, sides chartaceous, nerves 0, yellowish green to mid-brown, keel acute, 3-nerved, glaucous. Stamens 3; anthers 2.8–3 mm long. Nutlets broadly elliptic to obovate orbicular, 1–1.5 by 0.8–1 mm, maturing shiny black, minutely punctate.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms 3–15 cm by 1–2 mm. Leaves: blade linear, 3–8 cm by 4–5 mm, acute, canaliculate; sheath 1–1.5 cm long, light to reddish brown. Involucral bracts 3–6(–8), the lowest one up to 8 cm long. Inflorescence 1–2 by 1–3 cm. Spikes ellipsoid to ovoid, 1–3 by 0.7–1 cm. Spikelets ovoid, terete to weakly laterally flattened, 4–5 by 1–2 mm. Glumes ovate to broadly ovate, 3–4.5 by 1.5–1.7 mm, acute to mucronate, sides membranous to chartaceous, 3–5-nerved, pale to mid-brown, keel obtuse, brown. Stamens 3; anthers 2 mm long. Nutlet 2.5 by 0.7 mm, maturing greyish brown, smooth.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms loosely to densely tufted (30–)50–140 cm by 1–3 mm, trigonous to triquetrous above, smooth or scabrid above. Leaves basal and 2–4 cauline, blade linear, 10–60 cm by 3–5 mm, long-acuminate, flattish to plicate; basal sheaths yellowish brown to mid-brown, cauline sheaths greenish. Involucral bracts leaf-like, the longest up to 13 cm long. Inflorescence narrow, panicle-like, 20–40 cm long, with 3–5(–6) nodes eachi subtending 1–3 pedunculate spikelet clusters. Spikelets up to 15 per cluster, ovate-lanceolate, 6–8 by 1.5–2.5 mm. Glumes 5–8, ovate to ovate lanceolate, 1–5 cm long, acute to mucronate, sides membranous, mid-brown to rusty brown. Perianth segments 6, longer than nutlet. Stamens 2(–3); anthers 2–2.5 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets broadly obovate, compressed. 1.9–2.5 by 1.5–1.8 mm, slightly shiny, yellowish to mid-brown, weakly transversely wrinkled and lineolate; style base conical, gradually widening below.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms 1-few, 80–120(–150) cm by 3–10 mm, trigonous, smooth to scabrid above. Leaves basal and 2–3 cauline; blade broadly linear, 20–70 cm by 0.8–1.6 mm, long-acuminate, flattish, glabrous; basal sheathis up to 20 cm long, pale brown, cauline sheaths 5–8 cm long, greenish. Involucral bracts leaf-like, the longest 10–30 cm long. Inflorescence panicle-like, open, 20–40 cm long, comprising 2–5 rather distant partial inflorescences, the terminal one corymb-like, 10–15 by 10–15 cm, simple to compound, with primary rays (8–)12-many, up to 12 cm long. Spikelets in clusters of 2–10, lanceolate or elliptic, subterete, 6–9 mm long. Glumes 5–7, subdistichous, ovate to oblong-ovate, 2.5–6 mm long, acute to mucronulate, sides membranous, reddish brown. Perianth segments in bisexual flower 6, ± equalling nutlet. Stamens 3; anthers 2–3 mm long. Style 6 undivided. Nutlets obdeltoid-obovate, compressed, 2.5–3.5 by 2 mm, apex without short neck, glabrous, dull yellowish brown to mid-brown, finely transversely wrinkled to rugose; style base elongated-conical, 4–5 mm long.

description: Annual or short-lived perennial. Culms densely tufted, 20–60 cm by 0.2–0.5 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal; blade setaceous, up to 30 by 0.5–1.3 mm, subacute, canaliculate; sheath 1–4 cm long, light green to light brown. Involucral bracts leaf-like, the longest 2–4 cm long. Inflorescence 8–20 cm long, with 1–3 nodes each with 1 open partial inflorescence; terminal partial inflorescence up to 4 cm long, with primary and secondary rays; primary rays 3–5, up to 4 cm long. Spikelets up to 7 per partial inflorescence, solitary, lanceolate, 5–7 by 1.5–2 mm. Glumes 6–7(–8), ovate to broadly ovate, 2–4 cm long, subacute to mucronulate, sides membranous, light rusty brown. Perianth segments 0. Stamens 2; anthers 1.7–2 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets obovate orbicular, compressed, 1.2–1.5 by 1.2–1.5 mm, light grey, undulate-rugose with 6–8 ridges; style-base depressed-conical, much wider than long.
