description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms 20–50 cm by 0.8–1.5 mm, triquetrous, glabrous to pubescent. Leaves basal; blade linear, up to 33 cm by 1.5–4 mm, acute, flattish to conduplicate, ciliate along margins and abaxial midrib; sheath up to 2 cm long, light reddish to greenish. Involucral bracts 2–4, leaf-like, eventually reflexed, densely ciliate, the longest 2–4 cm long. Inflorescence capitate, subglobose to globose, 12–17 mm wide, chestnut brown. Spikelets many, ovate-lanceolate, flattened, 5.5–6.5 by 2 mm. Glumes 6–7, ovate to ovate-lanceolate, 1.5–4 cm long, acute, sides chartaceous, mid brown, somewhat shiny. Perianth segments 5–6, up to ⅔ as long as nutlet. Stamens 2; anthers 1.3–1.5 mm long. Style ± undivided. Nutlets obovate to broadly obovate, 2–2.5 by 1.5–1.8 mm, bilaterally compressed, pale brown to chestnut brown, somewhat shiny, smooth or with scattered tubercles; style base conical or depressed-conical.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Culms usually solitary, 60–100(–160) cm by 4–7 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves mostly basal, 2–3 cauline; blade broadly linear, 20–50 cm by 0.8–1.5 cm, acute, flat to plicate below; basal sheaths up to 10 cm long, brownish, cauline sheaths 2–5 cm long, glaucous. Involucral bracts leaf-like, the longest 7–16 cm long. Inflorescence panicle-like, 25–50 cm long, comprising (1–)2–4 distant partial inflorescences the terminal one corymb-like, simple to compound, 10-20 by 7–15 cm. with primary rays up to 12, 8–20 cm long. Spikelets in clusters of 2–6, ovate-lanceolate or ovate, subterete, 6–8 mm long. Glumes 6–7, subdistichous, ovate, 3–6 mm long. mucronulate, sides chartaceous, pale rusty brown. Perianth segments in bisexual flower 6, slightly longer than nutlet. Stamens 3; anthers 3 mm long. Style ± undivided. Nutlets broadly obovate to suborbicular, biconvex, 3.5–5 by 2–3 mm, apex abruptly narrowed into short neck between nutlets and style-base, hispid above, shiny blackish brown, densely punctulate; style-base conical-subulate, 3–4 mm long.

description: Annual. Culms tufted, 15–57 cm by 1 mm, trigonous, smooth. Leaves basal; blade linear, up to 19 cm by 1–3 mm, gradually narrowed, subacute, flattish; sheaths up to 6 cm long, pale brown. Involucral bracts 4–7, leaf-like, the longest up to 10 cm long. Inflorescence capitate, subglobose to globose, 2.5–3.5 cm wide. Spikelets many, linear lanceolate, ± terete, 11–14 by 1.2–1.5 mm. Glumes 6–7, distichous, ovate-lanceolate, to linear-lanceolate, 4–10 mm long, sides chartaceous, yellowish brown to mid-brown. Perianth segments 6, longer than nutlet. Stamens 2; anthers 2.5–3 mm long. Style undivided. Nutlets oblong, dorsiventrally compressed, 3.5–4 by 1.25 mm, mid- to dark brown, minutely prickly toward apex, minutely papillose; style-base narrowly conical, up to 2 mm long.

description: Annual or short-lived perennial. Culms tufted, 20–70(-100) cm by 1–2 mm, trigonous below, triquetrous above. Leaves basal; blade narrowly linear, up to 42 cm by 1.5–3(–4) mm, subacute, flattish to folded or canaliculate; sheath 1–7 cm long, yellowish brown. Involucral bracts 4–8, leaf-like, eventually reflexed, the longest up to 8 cm long, base dilated, margins ciliate. Inflorescence subglobose, to globose, 10–17 mm wide. Spikelets many, ovate-lanceolate, somewhat flattened, 6–8 by 1.5–2 mm. Glumes 6–8, ovate to lanceolate, up to 6.5 mm long, acute, sides thinly chartaceous, pale to mid-brown. Perianth segments 3–6, up to half the length of nutlet. Style ± undivided. Nutlets obovate to broadly obovate, bilaterally compressed, 1.3–1.8 by 1–1.5 mm, scabrid-hispid along margins, maturing somewhat shiny mid-brown, smooth to indistinctly minutely papillose; style-base depressed-conical.

description: Rhizomatous perennial. Rhizome short. Culms loosely tufted, 30–70 cm by 1–1.7 mm, trigonous, smooth to scabrid above. Leaves basal and 2–3 cauline; blade narrowly linear, up to 55 cm by 1.5–3 mm, gradually acute, flattish to canaliculate; basal sheath up 8 cm long, greyish brown, cauline sheath up to 5 cm long, greenish. Involucral bracts leaf-like, the longest up to 20 cm long. Inflorescence narrow, panicle-like, 10–30 cm long, with 2–3(–4) distant nodes each subtending 1–3 pedunculate spikelet clusters, the clusters rarely with primary and secondary rays. Spikelets 2–40 per cluster, ovate-lanceolate to ovate-elliptic, subterete, 3–4.5 mm long. Glumes 5–7, ovate to broadly ovate, 1–3.5 mm long, acute, mucronate, sides thinly chartaceous, dark brown. Perianth segments 6(–7), shorter or slightly longer than nutlet. Stamens (1–)2–3, anthers 1–1.5 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets broadly obovate, biconvex, 1.5–1.8 by 1–1.5 mm, maturing light brown, weakly transversely wrinkled and lineolate with longitudinally oblong epidermal cells; style-base conical, ± as broad as nutlets abruptly widening below.

description: Annual. Culms solitary or ± tufted, 15–60 cm by 1–2 mm, terete to ± trigonous above, smooth. Leaves basal; blade linear, up to 20 cm by 1.5–4 mm, subobtuse, spongy, flattish-plicate or with slightly inrolled margins; sheaths 1–10 cm long, dusky brown. Involucral bracts 3–6, leaf-like, erect to spreading, the longest 3–10(–20) cm long. Inflorescence capitate, subglobose to globose, 1–1.5 cm wide. Spikelets narrowly lanceolate, somewhat flattened, 4–5.5 by 1 mm. Glumes 5–6, distichous, ovate-lanceolate, up to 4.6 mm long, acute, sides membranous, yellowish brown to rusty brown. Perianth segments 6, equalling style-base. Stamens 1–2; anthers 1.5 mm long. Style ± undivided. Nutlets oblong, dorsiventrally compressed, 2.3–3 by 0.8–0.9 mm, dark brown with whitish angles, mostly whitish setulose; style-base deltoid.

description: Perennial. Culms tufted, erect or weakly recurved, terete, 4–30 cm by 4–9 mm, transversely septate, hollow, smooth. Leaf sheaths several; upper 2 sheaths 3–20 cm long, apex obliquely truncate; lower sheaths scale-like, 1–1.5 cm long. Involucral bract 1, 20–60 cm long, equalling or usually longer than culm, subacute, base hardly widened, septate. Inflorescence pseudolateral, capitate, with up to 60 or more spikelets; small, secondary inflorescence present at culm base. Spikelets cylindric or oblong, subterete to obscurely angular, 7–15 by 3–4 mm, light green with reddish tinge. Glumes ovate, 3.5–5 mm long, acute, mucronate, finely many-veined, pale greenish often tinged with red. Perianth segments 0. Stamens 3. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly obovoid, triquetrous, sides concave, 1.8–2 by 1.5 mm, maturing dark brown, smooth.

description: Perennial. Culms tufted, 15–70 cm by 1–3 mm, subterete or obtusely several angled. Leaf sheaths 3–4, lower scale-like, brownish, upper 5–15 cm long, obliquely truncate, mucronate. Involucral bract 1, 1.5–15 cm long, abruptly subacute, base dilated, 1-furrowed on ventral side. Inflorescence pseudolateral, capitate, with (1–)2–12 spikelets. Spikelets oblong to ovoid-oblong. 6–18 by 3–6 mm, pale yellowish brown. Glumes oval to ovate-oval, 3–4 by 1.8–2.7 mm, rounded to shallowly emarginate and mucronate, thickly membranous, pale brown, keel green, 1–3-nerved. Perianth segments 4–6, ± retrorsely scabrous, the 4 equalling or slightly longer than nutlet, remainder ± as long as nutlets or less. Stamens 3. Stigmas 2(–3), one of them rudimentary. Nutlets broadly obovate, unequally biconvex. 1.8–2 by 1.5 mm, maturing shiny dark brown, transversely wrinkled.

description: Perennial. Stolons terminated by a tuber. Culms erect, 60–150 cm by 0.5–0.8 mm, terete to trigonous below inflorescence, smooth. Leaf sheaths cylindric, 4–20 cm long, membranous, septate-nodulose, becoming fibrous with age, apex with a recurved setaceous blade 5–10 mm long. Involucral bract 1, subcompressed, ± equalling inflorescence, obtuse. Inflorescence paniculate, simple; branches 3–7, unequal, up to 5 cm long, scabrous, terminated by 1–3 spikelets. Spikelets oblong-ovate or elliptic-ovate, 7–15 by 3–4 mm, rusty brown. Glumes oblong-ovate or elliptic, 3.5–4 by 1.8–2 mm, ± obtuse, shortly mucronate, rust brown, the margins tinged red. Perianth segments 3–4, broadly linear to ± spathulate, slightly exceeding nutlet, fimbriate. Stamens 3; anthers 2 mm long. Stigmas 2. Nutlets broadly obovate, biconvex, 2 by 1.5–1.7 mm, somewhat shiny, chestnut brown, very minutely papillose.

description: Perennial. Rhizome short, horizontal, sometimes slightly elongate with culms arranged in a row. Culms erect, 25–100 cm by 4–9 mm, triquetrous, smooth, sides concave. Leaf sheaths 7–20 cm long, acute or rounded, mucronate, septate-nodulose below. Involucral bract 1, erect or patent, later deflexed, triquetrous, 2.5–6 cm long, blunt-pointed. Inflorescence pseudolateral, capitate, with (1–)2–10 spikelets. Spikelets sessile, ovate or oblong, 6–20 by 3–6 mm, terete or obscurely angular, pale yellowish brown. Glumes oval or ovate-orbicular, 2.8–4 by 2–3 mm, obtuse, subulate-mucronulate, minutely ciliolate along upper margin, many-nerved, pale brown or reddish brown. Perianth segments 6, needle-like, slightly shorter or equalling nutlet. Stamens 3. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly ovate, compressed-triangular, 1.8–2.2 by 1.5–1.8 mm, shiny black-brown, transversely wrinkled.

description: Annual. Culms tufted, 7–30 cm by 1–2 mm, trigonous. Leaf sheaths 5–15 cm long, apex obliquely truncate, mucronate, the uppermost sheath sometimes with a compressed-triangular blade to 10 cm long. Involucral bracts 1(–2), the lower bract erect, 3–12 cm long, ventrally sulcate. Inflorescence pseudolateral, capitate or short, paniculate, simple, branches 4, unequal, with 3–20 spikelets, small secondary inflorescence often present at culm base. Spikelets ovate-lanceolate to oblong, 4–8 by 2–3 mm. Glumes elliptic, boat-shaped, 1.8–2.5 mm long, acute, mucronate, green to pale yellowish brown. Perianth segments 0, rarely rudimentary. Stamens 3. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly obovoid, triquetrous, 1–1.3 mm long, maturing black, sides transversely wrinkled.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Schoenoplectus supinus lateriflorus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 279. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial. Rhizome short, woody. Culms 30–80 cm by 1–2 mm, subterete, smooth, glabrous. Leaves mostly basal, distichous, 1–3-cauline; blade narrowly linear, up to 30 cm by 1.5–2 mm, abruptly acute, folded, glaucous; basal sheath up to 6 mm long, reddish to dark purple brown, cauline sheath up to 3 cm long. Involucral bracts several, leaf like, lowest bract 1–4 cm long. Inflorescence panicle-like, 20–50 cm long, with 2–5 nodes, each subtending 1–2(–3) pedunculate spikelets; peduncles 2–12 cm long. Spikelets lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, acute, 20–25 by 3–5 mm, 9–14-glumed, 3–5-flowered. Glumes lanceolate, 1.5–2 cm by 3–4 mm, acute, sides chartaceous, mid-brown, keel acute, the lower 4–9 glumes empty, becoming shorter. Perianth segments 4–6, shorter than nutlet. Stamens 3; anthers 7–8 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly ovoid to ovoid, trigonous, 3–3.5 by 1.5 mm, maturing blackish brown, irregularly transversely wrinkled.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Schoenus calostachyus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 6. Part 4, 1998. Pg. 420. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial. Rhizome short, woody. Culms 60–100(–150) cm by 2–5 mm, obtusely angular, smooth, glabrous. Leaves mostly basal, 3–4-cauline; blade narrowly linear, rigid, 90 cm by 2–7 mm, long-acuminate channelled, glabrous; basal sheath 3–5 cm long, dark purplish, cauline sheath 1.5–3 cm long. Involucral bracts several, lowest bract 3–16 cm long. Inflorescence narrow, panicle-like, 20–40 cm long, with 4–10 distant nodes each subtending 2–4 partial inflorescences. Spikelets many, shortly peduncled, oblong-lanceolate, weakly flattened, 7–14 by 2.5 mm, 8–10-glumed, 3–8 flowered. Glumes ovate-lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate, 5–7 by 1 mm, acute, mucronate, sides chartaceous, brown, margins paler, keel acute, yellow green, the lower 2–5 glumes empty, shorter. Perianth segments 1–3, ± equalling nutlet. Stamens 3; anthers 3 mm long. Stigmas 3. Nutlets broadly elliptic or obovate, trigonous, 1–1.3 by 0.8–1 mm, apex pubescent, rust brown, pitted-reticulate with large epidermal cells.

description: Similar to S. falcatus but: Culms slender. Leaves slender, blade 1–3 mm wide, margins inrolled. Inflorescence ± nodding. Spikelets 5–7 mm long, 1–2-flowered. Upper glumes 4–5 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Perennial. Rhizome short, woody. Culms densely tufted, 20–30 cm by 1.25–2 mm, trigonous, smooth, glabrous. description: Annual. Culms tufted, 60-90 cm by 2–3 mm, triquetrous, angles ± wing-like, smooth. Leaves cauline; blade linear, 15-30 cm by 3–7 mm, flattish-plicate, subacute; sheath 4–9 cm long, winged or wingless, mid-brown to dark reddish purple; contraligule depressed-rounded, hispid-ciliate. Lowest involucral bract leaf-like, 10–30 cm long. Inflorescence paniculate, up to 30 cm long; nodes 3–5, distant, each subtending a single partial inflorescence; partial inflorescence sessile to shortly pedunculate, mostly simple or with very short branches, bracteoles prominent. Spikelets unisexual, solitary or in pairs; female spikelets turbinate, 6–7 mm long; male spikelets cylindrical, 6–7 mm long. Glumes ovate-deltoid, 4.2–5.5 mm long, acute to acuminate, sides membranous, pale to mid-brown. Stamens 3. Nutlets broadly ovoid to ovoid-globose, trigonous to 5 terete, 2.5–3 by 2.2–2.5 mm, milky white, scrobiculate with longitudinally oblong lacunae, glabrous; disk deeply 3-lobed, lobes obovate-orbicular, rounded at apex.

description: Annual. Culms tufted, 15–40 cm by 1–2 mm, triquetrous, glabrous. Leaves cauline; blade narrowly linear, 7–15 cm by 1–2.5 mm, ± obtuse, folded, glabrous; sheath 1.5–3 cm long, wingless, purplish red; contraligule obtuse-deltoid, glabrous or minutely ciliolate. Lowest involucral bract leaf-like, up to 10 cm long. Inflorescence paniculate, up to 13 cm long; nodes 3–4, distant, each subtending 1–2 partial inflorescences; partial inflorescences short to long-pedunculate, 1–2 cm long, with few spikelets. Spikelets unisexual, solitary or in pairs; female spikelets obovate or broadly obovate, 3.5–4 mm long; male spikelets pedunculate, linear-lanceolate, 2–2.5 mm long. Glumes ovate, 3–3.8 mm long, acute or mucronate, sides membranous, pale green or yellowish brown, keel green. Stamen 1. Nutlets globose or broadly ovoid-globose, 1.2–1.8 by 1.2–1.8 mm, shiny creamy white, smooth, glabrous; disk obtusely triangular, hardly to very shallowly 3-lobed.

description: Rhizomatous perennial; rhizome horizontally creeping. Culms 1-few, 20–30–70(–90) cm by 1.5–2 mm, triquetrous, glabrous to puberulent above. Leaves 5–8, mostly basal, 1–2 cauline; blade linear-lanceolate, 5–15 cm by 5–15 mm, abruptly acute, flat, pubescent to glabrescent; sheath 1–4 cm long, purplish or brownish red; contraligule narrow, membranous, dark red-brown. Involucral bracts leaf-like, oblong-lanceolate, 1.5–5 cm long. Inflorescence solitary, paniculate, terminal, rarely with a small lateral partial inflorescence below, ovoid or ellipsoid, 2–6 by 1.5–3 cm, branches less than 8 mm long; lower partial inflorescence ca 10 mm long. Spikelets bisexual and male, subsessile, 8–10 mm long. Glumes ovate-lanceolate, up to 8 mm long, acute to acuminate, sides membranous, light brown, keel pilose, green. Nutlets ellipsoid, terete, 2.5–2.7 by 2.2–2.5 mm, shiny white, smooth, glabrous; disk stipe-like, obtusely trigonous, not lobed.

description: Perennial. Culms tufted, 25–80 cm by 0.7–3 mm, subterete to trigonous, smooth to scabrid below inflorescence. Leaves reduced to bladeless sheaths; sheaths 5–18 cm long, obliquely truncate, mucronate or setaceous. Involucral bracts glume-like, 5–8 mm long, apex obtuse, shortly setose. Inflorescence with 1–5 spikelets. Spikelets ovate-lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, 5–15 by 2 mm, pale brown to rusty brown, lower spikelets on a peduncle 0.5–2.5 mm wide. Glumes caducous, 3–5 by 1.5–2.5 mm, subobtuse, membranous, 3-nerved, pale brown to rusty brown. Perianth segments 6.5–7 mm long, silky, curled, sparsely spinulose below apex. Nutlets elliptic to oblong, flattened-trigonous, 1.8–2.2 by 0.6–1 mm, greyish brown, minutely punctate.

description: Perennial. Culms densely tufted, 30–90 cm by 1–2 mm, trigonous, smooth, glabrous. Leaves basal; blade rather rigid, linear, 1–3 mm, subobtuse, deeply channelled, margins inrolled; sheath up to 5 cm long, brown or reddish brown. Involucral bracts several, leaf-like, the lowest 5–15 cm long. Inflorescence open to dense, 10–20 by 3–4 cm with (3–)4–5 nodes each subtending 2–3 partial inflorescences. Spikelets inclusters of 2–8, lanceolate, 4–5 by 1–1.5 mm, 4-glumed, 1-flowered. Glumes ovate to oblong-lanceolate, 2–5 by ca 1 mm, acute, sides membranous, several-veined, reddish brown. Perianth segments (3–)6, 0.3–0.5 mm long, densely hispidulous. Stamens 2–3; anthers 2 mm long. Nutlets elliptic to ovate-elliptic, trigonous to subterete 1.3–1.5 by 0.6–0.8 mm, blackish brown, rugose-reticulate.
